item.g:title: Vetrica Probiotic Chews for Health Digestive with Duck Flavor 130 Soft Chew
item.g:description: Prebiotic dog food is a type of pet food that contains prebiotics—special types of dietary fibers that support the growth of beneficial bacteria in your dog’s gut. These fibers are not digested by the dog itself but instead serve as food for the good bacteria in the digestive system. This helps maintain a healthy balance of gut flora, which is essential for overall health, digestion, and immune function. The importance of prebiotic dog food lies in its ability to support digestive health and enhance the immune system. A healthy gut is the foundation of a healthy dog, and prebiotics play a crucial role in maintaining that balance. When your dog consumes prebiotic-rich food, it encourages the growth of beneficial bacteria like Bifidobacteria and Lactobacilli, which help break down food more efficiently, absorb nutrients, and prevent the overgrowth of harmful bacteria. In addition to digestive benefits, prebiotic dog food can also help reduce the risk of certain health issues, such as gastrointestinal disorders, allergies, and even obesity. Many pet owners are turning to prebiotic dog food as a natural and effective way to support their dog’s long-term health and well-being.

item.g:title: Hollow Mouth Loose Ring Snaffle Steel
item.g:description: Loose ring thick jointed snaffles have long been regarded as one of the kindest bits to ride your horse in and a lot of youngsters are put into them after breaking. They have lost favour in the modern bitting world as more is now known about the horses mouth, and generally there is less room for a thick bit to sit comfortably. The french link is often confused with the Dr Bristol as both have a plate in the middle, but the french link snaffle is at the mild end of the bitting spectrum. The centre plate in a french link eggbutt is shaped and lies flat on the horses tongue causing little to no pressure when in use. The double jointed mouthpiece eases pressure on the bars of the horses mouth and prevents palate pressure, making the french link one of the best bits for novice horses and riders. Larger horses with plenty of space for a bit may find this bit comfortable, and it can be useful for the rider if the horse occasionally tries to get his tongue over the bit. The thicker mouthpiece is not ideal to use with a horse with a thicker tongue, but can be good for horses with sensitive bars. Korsteel Stainless Steel Hollow Mouth French Link Loose Ring Snaffle Bit features: Can be used in dressage competitions Hollow mouth makes the bit lightweight and softer on the bar Bit strength: fairly mild

item.g:title: Virbac Cortavance 76ml
item.g:description: Virbac Cortavance 76ml HYDROCORTISONE ACEPONATE TOPICAL SPRAY SOLUTION VETERINARY USE ONLY ■ DESCRIPTION: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is formulated with the active ingredient, hydrocortisone aceponate, 0.584 mg per mL in a suitable solvent, propylene glycol methyl ether for dermatologic use in dogs. Hydrocortisone aceponate is a dermocorticoid with a potent intrinsic glucocorticoid activity. ■ THERAPEUTIC CLASSIFICATION: Glucocorticoid ■ INDICATIONS: CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray is indicated for the symptomatic treatment of inflammatory and pruritic skin conditions in dogs. ■ DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Before administration, remove the cap and screw the pump spray on the bottle. The product is applied by activating the pump. Spray from a distance of about 10 cm above the area of skin to be treated. The recommended dose is 1.52 µg of hydrocortisone aceponate per cm2 of skin surface. This dose can be achieved with 2 pump spray activations over a 10 cm x 10 cm square surface area of skin. Leave treated area to dry. Presented as a volatile spray, this product does not require any massage. Care should be taken to avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. Repeat treatment once daily for 7 consecutive days. If no improvement is seen within 7 days, treatment should be re-evaluated by the veterinarian. ■ CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do not use on cutaneous ulcers. ■ CAUTIONS: Total body surface treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray should not exceed a surface corresponding to, for example, two flanks from the spine to mammary chains including the shoulders and thighs (1/3 of dog’s body). Avoid spraying in the eyes of the dog. In the case of concurrent microbial, fungal infections and flea infestations, dogs should receive appropriate treatment. If a favourable response does not occur promptly, treatment should be discontinued until the infection has been adequately controlled. Not for use in animals with hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing’s Disease). Since glucocorticoids are known to slow growth, use in young animals (under 7 months of age) is not recommended. Not for use in breeding, pregnant or lactating animals, as the safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has not been established. As with all glucocorticoids, the use of this product may adversely affect the Hypothalamic Pituitary Adrenal axis (HPA axis). Do not exceed the recommended dose or duration of treatment. Not for use in sick or debilitated animals. It is not recommended to apply other topical preparations simultaneously on the same lesion. ■ WARNINGS: Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental contact with skin, it is recommended to wash thoroughly with water. Wash hands after use. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of accidental eye contact, rinse with abundant quantities of water. In case of eye irritation, seek medical advice. Avoid inhalation of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical advice immediately and show the labelling to the physician. Spray in a well ventilated area. Flammable. Do not spray on naked flame or any incandescent material. ■ ADVERSE REACTIONS: Although not all adverse reactions are reported, the following adverse reaction information is based on voluntary post-approval drug experience reporting. It is generally recognized that this method of reporting results in significant under-reporting of adverse drug reactions. It should be noted that suspected ADRs listed here reflect reporting and not causality. Transient local reactions at the application site (erythema and/or pruritis) can occur in very rare cases (less than 1 in 10,000 animals). ■ CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY: Hydrocortisone aceponate belongs to the diester class of glucocorticoids. Diesters are lipophilic substances of low plasma availability that effectively penetrate the skin to accumulate at the site of inflammation without significant systemic absorption. Once inside the skin, the diesters are transformed to deliver anti-inflammatory activity. In laboratory animals, hydrocortisone aceponate is eliminated like endogenous cortisol, through the urine and faeces. ■ SAFETY AND EFFICACY STUDY INFORMATION: The safety of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray in dogs was demonstrated in two studies using 1X, 3X and 5X the therapeutic dose for 14 consecutive days in young dogs. Dogs with 3X and 5X the recommended dose for twice the recommended duration of treatment resulted in a reduced capacity for production of cortisol that was reversible within 7 to 9 weeks after the end of treatment. No adverse effects were seen during the clinical studies. Clinical efficacy of CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray has been demonstrated in a multi-site, controlled clinical field trial in dogs under normal conditions of use. In this study, 105 dogs (54 dogs treated with CORTAVANCETM Topical Spray; 51 dogs as positive control) representing 33 breeds were diagnosed with the following skin dermatoses: Skin Dermatoses % Flea Allergy Dermatitis ……………………………………. 29% Acute Moist Dermatitis (hot spot)

item.g:title: Revolution Topical Solution for Dogs, 40.1-85 lbs - 1 Pipette
item.g:description: Your furry friend must have a current heartworm test result on file with your veterinarian in order to be prescribed heartworm medication. Please visit your veterinarian to have this test performed annually to protect your four-legged friend. Revolution is a medication that is applied directly on your furry friend's skin to protect them from biting critters. When applied every 30 days, Revolution protects against heartworms, fleas, and ear mites. It's also effective in preventing and treating roundworms and hookworms in kittens and sarcoptic mange and American dog tick infestations in puppies. Uses Revolution is formulated to kill adult fleas and prevents flea eggs from hatching for one month. It is also indicated for the prevention and control of flea infestations, prevention of heartworm disease caused by Dirofilaria immitis, and the treatment and control of ear mite infestations. Revolution is also indicated for the treatment and control of sarcoptic mange and for the control of tick infestations due to Dermacentor variabilis. Possible Side Effects In safety studies, Revolution was administered at 1, 3, 5, and 10 times the recommended dose to sixweek-old puppies, and no adverse reactions were observed. When tested for oral ingestion at the recommended topical dose in 5 to 8-month-old beagles, no adverse reactions were observed. In a topical safety study conducted with avermectinsensitive collies at 1, 3 and 5 times the recommended dose of Revolution, salivation was observed in all treatment groups. Revolution also was administered at 3 times the recommended dose to heartworm infected dogs, and no adverse effects were observed. If side effects do occur, please contact your veterinarian immediately. Drug Food Interactions Talk to your veterinarian about any other drugs your dog is taking before starting this medication. Precautions Prior to administration of Revolution, dogs should be tested for existing heartworm infections. At the discretion of the veterinarian, infected dogs should be treated to remove adult heartworms. Revolution is not effective against adult D. immitis and, while the number of circulating microfilariae may decrease following treatment, Revolution is not effective for microfilariae clearance. Hypersensitivity reactions have not been observed in dogs with patent heartworm infections administered three times the recommended dose of Revolution. Higher doses were not tested. For use in animals only. Keep out of reach of children. Dosage Chart Color on Box Weight Range Strength Potency Volume Dosage MAUVE Up to 5 lbs 15 mg Selamectin per tube 60 mg/mL 0.25 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month PURPLE 5.1-10 lbs 30 mg Selamectin per tube 120 mg/mL 0.25 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month BROWN 10.1-20 lbs 60 mg Selamectin per tube 120 mg/mL 0.5 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month RED 20.1-40 lbs 120 mg Selamectin per tube 120 mg/mL 1.0 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month TEAL 40.1-85 lbs 240 mg Selamectin per tube 120 mg/mL 2.0 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month PLUM 85.1-130 lbs 360 mg Selamectin per tube 120 mg/mL 3.0 mL Administer entire contents of a single dose tube once a month

Formulated in such a way as to minimize the risk of allergic reactions (absence of allergenic substances). item.g:title: Virbac SEBOLYTIC SIS for Dog & Cat 250ML VBI
item.g:description: Virbac — SEBOLYTIC SIS | 250ml | Veterinary Keratolytic Seborrheic Shampoo for Dogs Cats The veterinary standard for seborrhea and scaling. Virbac SEBOLYTIC SIS is a veterinary-grade keratolytic and antiseborrheic shampoo formulated with three clinically proven active ingredients — sulfur, iodine, and salicylic acid — specifically designed to treat seborrheic skin conditions, excessive scaling, and keratoseborrheic disorders in dogs and cats. Seborrhea is one of the most common and frustrating dermatological conditions in pets — characterized by abnormal skin cell turnover that produces excessive scaling, greasy or dry skin, unpleasant odor, and secondary bacterial and yeast infections. Standard grooming shampoos cannot address seborrhea — the condition requires the specific keratolytic, keratoplastic, and antimicrobial actions that only veterinary-grade active ingredients can provide. Virbac SEBOLYTIC SIS delivers all three mechanisms simultaneously — salicylic acid dissolves the bonds between abnormal skin cells, sulfur normalizes skin cell turnover and provides antimicrobial action, and iodine provides broad-spectrum antimicrobial coverage against the bacteria and yeast that colonize seborrheic skin. The result: reduced scaling, normalized skin texture, reduced odor, and a healthier skin barrier — from the veterinary dermatology brand that professionals trust. 250ml — the veterinary shampoo that treats seborrhea at its source. Why Virbac SEBOLYTIC SIS Is The Best Choice Triple Active Formula — SIS — Sulfur, Iodine, and Salicylic acid — three clinically proven active ingredients working synergistically to address every aspect of seborrheic skin disease. Salicylic Acid — Keratolytic Action — Dissolves the abnormal bonds between hyperkeratotic skin cells — removing scales and allowing normal skin cell turnover to resume. Sulfur — Keratoplastic Antimicrobial — Normalizes the rate of skin cell production (keratoplastic effect) and provides antimicrobial action against the bacteria and yeast that colonize seborrheic skin. Iodine — Broad-Spectrum Antimicrobial — Provides broad-spectrum antimicrobial coverage against bacteria, yeast (Malassezia), and fungi — addressing the secondary infections that complicate seborrhea. Seborrhea Treatment — Specifically formulated for seborrheic skin conditions — both seborrhea sicca (dry, flaky) and seborrhea oleosa (greasy, oily). Keratoseborrheic Disorders — Effective for the full spectrum of keratoseborrheic conditions including primary seborrhea, secondary seborrhea, and scaling disorders. Odor Reduction — The antimicrobial action reduces the bacterial and yeast overgrowth that produces the characteristic unpleasant odor of seborrheic skin. For Dogs Cats — Formulated for use in both species — a versatile veterinary shampoo for multi-pet households. Virbac — Veterinary Dermatology Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — the veterinary dermatology brand that professionals trust. 250ml — A practical clinical shampoo size for ongoing dermatological management. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac SEBOLYTIC SIS bottle with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a well-groomed dog or cat with healthy, scale-free skin — communicating the skin health the shampoo restores.) Product Details Features Understanding Seborrhea in Dogs and Cats Seborrhea is a disorder of keratinization — the process by which skin cells are produced, mature, and shed. In normal skin, this process is tightly regulated — skin cells are produced at the base of the epidermis, mature as they migrate to the surface, and are shed invisibly. In seborrhea, this process is dysregulated — skin cells are produced too rapidly, mature abnormally, and accumulate on the skin surface as visible scales. Types of seborrhea: Seborrhea sicca (dry seborrhea): Characterized by dry, flaky, white or gray scales Skin feels dry and rough Scales shed easily and accumulate in the coat and environment Common in breeds with dry skin tendencies Seborrhea oleosa (oily seborrhea): Characterized by greasy, yellowish scales that adhere to the skin and coat Skin feels oily and has a characteristic rancid odor Scales are sticky and difficult to remove Common in breeds with oily skin tendencies (Cocker Spaniels, Basset Hounds) Mixed seborrhea: Most common presentation — elements of both dry and oily seborrhea Variable presentation depending on body region Primary vs. secondary seborrhea: Primary seborrhea: An inherited disorder of keratinization — the skin cell turnover process is genetically dysregulated Breed-specific — most common in Cocker Spaniels, West Highland White Terriers, Basset Hounds, Labrador Retrievers, and Persian cats Lifelong condition requiring ongoing management Secondary seborrhea: Seborrhea as a symptom of an underlying condition — the most common presentation Underlying causes include: hypothyroidism, hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing's disease), allergies (food or env

item.g:title: IMac Ciottoli Double Bowel Feeder for Pet
item.g:description: IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli for Pets One station. Two bowls. Everything your pet needs, right where they need it. The IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli brings the same smooth, pebble-inspired Italian design of the single Ciottoli to a twin-bowl format — giving you a dedicated food and water station in a single, elegant unit that keeps feeding areas organized, tidy, and genuinely beautiful. Available in two sizes to suit cats and small-to-medium dogs, the Double Feeder Ciottoli is the upgrade that makes daily feeding simpler, cleaner, and more considered. Why IMac Double Feeder Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Two bowls, one station — the double format keeps food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit, eliminating the clutter of separate bowls scattered across the floor Italian design heritage — IMac's signature pebble-inspired aesthetic brings a clean, considered look to the feeding area that single-purpose plastic bowls simply can't match Ideal food + water combination — the most practical use of the double format; having water always adjacent to food encourages better hydration habits, particularly in cats who are reluctant drinkers Stable, wide-base design — the joined double-bowl unit has a naturally wider footprint than two separate bowls, making it significantly more stable and resistant to tipping during enthusiastic feeding Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food or water residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Two sizes for cats and small-to-medium dogs — the 0.3+0.3L suits cats and toy breeds; the 0.6+0.6L handles small-to-medium dogs and larger cats comfortably Barcodes present on both variants ✓ — full product traceability Product Details Features The Double Feeder Ciottoli solves one of the most common practical frustrations of pet ownership: the perpetually sliding, tipping, or scattered bowl situation. By joining two Ciottoli bowls into a single unit with a shared base, IMac creates a feeding station that stays exactly where you put it, presents food and water in a clean, organized way, and takes up a defined, predictable footprint in your home. The food-and-water combination is the most popular use case — and for good reason. Cats in particular benefit from having water consistently available adjacent to their food, as proximity to the food source is one of the factors that influences how much water they drink. For cats who are chronically underhydrated — a common issue that contributes to kidney and urinary tract problems — a double feeder that keeps water always in view and always accessible is a genuinely meaningful health intervention. The double format is also useful for multi-food households: raw and dry, wet and dry, or two different food types for cats with specific dietary requirements. The two bowls are independent in use but unified in design, giving owners flexibility without sacrificing the clean, organized look of the feeding area. The Ciottoli design language — smooth curves, rounded edges, no sharp corners — carries through to the double format, making it as easy to clean as the single bowl and as comfortable to handle when moving or washing. Key Features: Double bowl format — food + water or two food types in one station Italian design — smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic 2 sizes: 0.3+0.3L and 0.6+0.6L Wide, stable joined base — anti-tip, anti-slide design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean, no food-trapping corners Suitable for cats and dogs Durable construction — built for daily use

item.g:title: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean & Tidy
item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean Tidy Protect your pet from fleas and ticks with the Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean Tidy. This essential grooming tool features ultra-fine teeth specifically designed to catch and remove fleas, flea eggs, ticks, and debris from your pet's coat. Safe, chemical-free, and effective, this flea comb is a must-have for any pet owner committed to keeping their furry friend comfortable and pest-free. Why Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Is The Best Choice Fine-Tooth Design : Ultra-close teeth spacing effectively traps fleas, flea eggs, and ticks Chemical-Free Solution : Safe, natural flea removal without harsh chemicals or pesticides Early Detection : Helps you spot flea infestations before they become serious problems Gentle Safe : Smooth, rounded teeth won't scratch or irritate your pet's skin Multi-Purpose : Also removes dirt, debris, and loose fur while checking for parasites Product Details Features At petfast.shop, we understand that fleas and ticks are more than just a nuisance—they can cause serious health issues for your pet and infest your home. The Nunbell Pet Flea Comb provides a safe, effective way to detect and remove these parasites without exposing your pet to chemicals. The ultra-fine teeth are precisely spaced to catch even the smallest fleas and their eggs, making this an essential tool for flea prevention and control. Key Features: Ultra-fine, closely-spaced metal teeth Smooth, rounded tips prevent skin irritation Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip Durable stainless steel or high-quality metal construction Suitable for dogs and cats of all sizes Works on all coat types and lengths Easy to clean between uses Lightweight and easy to maneuver Chemical-free, safe for puppies and kittens Essential for flea monitoring and removal Usage Guide Flea Detection Suitable For: Dogs and cats of all sizes and coat types Ideal For: Flea detection, flea removal, tick removal, parasite monitoring How to Use: Prepare Your Pet : Ensure your pet is calm and comfortable Start at the Head : Begin combing from the head, working toward the tail Comb Thoroughly : Work through the entire coat in small sections, paying special attention to warm areas where fleas congregate Check the Comb : After each stroke, examine the comb for fleas, flea dirt, or eggs Dip in Water : Keep a bowl of soapy water nearby to dip the comb and drown captured fleas Focus on Hot Spots : Pay extra attention to neck, ears, armpits, groin, and base of tail Repeat Regularly : Use daily during infestations, weekly for prevention Key Areas to Check: Fleas prefer warm, protected areas on your pet's body: Around the neck and collar area Behind and inside the ears Under the front legs (armpits) Groin and belly area Base of the tail and lower back Between the toes Identifying Flea Infestation: What to Look For: Live Fleas : Small, dark brown insects that move quickly Flea Dirt : Black specks (flea feces) that turn red when wet Flea Eggs : Tiny white or translucent oval specks Excessive Scratching : Your pet scratching more than usual Red, Irritated Skin : Flea bites cause inflammation Hair Loss : From excessive scratching and biting Flea Dirt Test: Place suspected flea dirt on a white paper towel and add a drop of water. If it turns reddish-brown, it's flea feces (digested blood). Flea Control Best Practices: Regular Combing Schedule: During Infestation : Daily combing until fleas are eliminated Prevention : 2-3 times per week during flea season Year-Round Monitoring : Weekly checks even in winter Complete Flea Control Program: Treat Your Pet : Use flea comb plus veterinarian-recommended flea treatment Treat Your Home : Vacuum thoroughly, wash bedding, treat carpets and furniture Treat Outdoor Areas : Address yard and outdoor spaces where your pet spends time Prevent Re-Infestation : Maintain regular combing and preventive treatments Care Maintenance: Clean the comb after each use Remove trapped fleas and debris Wash with hot, soapy water Disinfect regularly with pet-safe cleaner Dry thoroughly before storing Store in a clean, dry location Replace if teeth become bent or damaged

item.g:title: Revolution (selamectin) for Cats - 1 Doses
item.g:description: **Revolution (selamectin) for Cats | 2.28 - 6.81kg | 3 x 0.7ml Revolution for Cats (Single dose) For Cats and Kittens, REVOLUTION is the most complete flea and heartworm protection. Revolution is extremely effective in keeping cats safe from hookworm, roundworm and ear mites, too. Unlike many other 'topical' (i.e. administered externally onto the body) parasiticides designed to treat fleas and other parasites in cats, Revolution is not a scheduled poison and is approved for use with kittens as young as 6 weeks old, as well as pregnant and lactating females. Revolution is a "spot-on" medication for cats that: ► Stops all stages of the flea (kills the adult flea and prevents eggs from hatching)► Prevents heartworm (Dirofilaria immitis) disease► Kills adult fleas (Ctenocephalides felis) and prevents their eggs from hatching► Treats and controls ear mites (Otodectes cynotis)► Treats and controls sarcoptic mange (Sarcoptes scabiei) and► Prevents heartworm► Can be used on kittens from 6 weeks and pregnant and lactating catsHow does it compare to other treatments? Quick Drying: Revolution is quick-drying, non-greasy and water fast, with no unpleasant odor, so you can cuddle and play with your cat as soon as Revolution dries.How does it work?Once you've applied it, Revolution for Cats is quickly absorbed into your pet's bloodstream, killing any heartworm larvae, as well as any roundworm and hookworm intestinal larvae, it encounters. As it moves into your cat's skin and hair, it gets down to the business of killing fleas and other external parasites. Revolution for Cats will then continue to fully protect your cat for an entire month, regardless of how long your cat's hair is. After the month is up, just apply a new dose.Internal and external protection for cats against:► Three stages of the flea (adult, eggs larvae)► Heartworm► Hookworm► Roundworm► Ear mites► Controls flea allergy dermatitisWhy do I need parasite protection for my pet?Fleas make your cat uncomfortable and can cause flea allergy dermatitis, which the most common skin allergy on both cats and dogs. Fleas can also transmit tapeworm and heartworm can lead to death.Are parasites in my pet a risk to me?Parasites like hookworms and roundworms can be transmitted to humans and cause a variety of health problems, including nausea, neurological problems, and even blindness.What makes Revolution the preferred parasite control product?Revolution is the first and only topical treatment to protect against a wide range of both external and internal parasites in dogs and cats. In the past, you needed multiple treatments that were difficult to remember, hard to use, and stressful for you and your pet.What is Heartworm?Heartworm disease is a potentially fatal disease caused by a parasite Dirofilaria immitis. The adult worms live in the heart and its vessels and can affect blood flow, leading to heart failure and death. Sometimes the first sign of heartworm infestation is a persistent cough relating to heart failure. Heartworm disease is spread by mosquitoes. Just one bite is enough to infect your dog or cat. The parasite larvae move through the tissues to the heart where they grow into adult worms.How is it used?Just a spot once a month in front of the shoulder blades is all your pet needs for protection against fleas, heartworm and other parasites. No pills. No sticky sprays. No more hassling with multiple products. No need to massage it in either. How often should I apply Revolution? Once a month.What should I do if I do not give Revolution on time or miss a dose?If you forget to apply a monthly dose of Revolution, immediately apply Revolution, resume monthly applications.When can I play with my pet following treatment with Revolution?You should avoid contact with application site when wet. You may hold or play with your pet any time after the area on which Revolution was applied is dry, within a couple of hours.Can Revolution be given with other medicines?In well-controlled clinical studies, Revolution was used safely in dogs and cats receiving other veterinary products such as vaccines, anthelmintics, antiparasitics, antibiotics, steroids, collars, shampoos and dips.

The IMac Dea Double Bowl brings the clean Italian design and anti-slip feet of the Dea single bowl to a twin-bowl format — a dedicated food and water station that keeps everything organized, stable, and beautifully presented side by side. Available in Blue and Red, at the most accessible price point in the IMac double bowl range, the Dea Double Bowl is the practical, well-designed choice for cat owners and small dog households who want a proper feeding station without compromise. Why IMac Dea Double Bowl Is the Best Choice Anti-slip feet — the Dea difference — rubber anti-slip feet on the base keep the double bowl station firmly in place during feeding, eliminating the sliding and tipping that makes mealtime messier than it needs to be; a feature not found on all double bowl formats at this price point Two bowls, one station — food and water (or two food types) side by side in a single, stable unit; no more scattered bowls, no more searching for where the water bowl ended up Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea single bowl, Dea Slow Feeder, and Dea Food Dispenser; a visually cohesive feeding area for owners building a complete Dea setup Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options for personalization, aesthetic matching, or easy visual differentiation in multi-pet households Most accessible double bowl in the IMac range — the Dea Double Bowl delivers the quality and design of the IMac lineup at the most approachable price point in the double bowl category Encourages better hydration — having water consistently adjacent to food is one of the most effective ways to increase water intake in cats, who are naturally reluctant drinkers Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product that works across species Product Details Features The Dea Double Bowl combines two of the Dea range's defining characteristics — the clean Italian aesthetic and the anti-slip rubber feet — in a twin-bowl format that solves the most common daily feeding frustration: bowls that move. The anti-slip feet create enough friction against tile, hardwood, and laminate to keep the station stationary even during enthusiastic feeding, making mealtimes calmer and cleaner for both pet and owner. The twin-bowl format is the most practical feeding station configuration available — one bowl for food, one for water, always together, always in the same place. For cats in particular, the proximity of water to food is a meaningful factor in daily hydration. Cats are naturally reluctant drinkers who often ignore a water bowl placed across the room; having water immediately adjacent to their food source significantly increases the likelihood of regular drinking, supporting kidney health and urinary tract function over the long term. The Dea Double Bowl sits at the most accessible price point in the IMac double bowl range — 300 EGP less than the Diva Double Bowl — making it the natural entry point for owners who want the quality and design of the IMac lineup without the premium of the Diva range. For owners already using Dea single bowls, the Dea Slow Feeder, or the Dea Food Dispenser, it's also the obvious choice for maintaining visual consistency across the feeding area. item.g:description: Royal Canin Medium Puppy Dry Food 15kg Medium-sized dogs are often more robust and agile than other dogs. They have a broad spectrum of activity, ranging from the quiet family dog to the high performance dog. The family dog may tend towards being overweight and needs measured food intake whereas the medium-sized performance dog (for example, hunting or racing dog) has high energy requirements. Rummaging in undergrowth, splashing in water etc. moreover requires special protection for skin and coat. Medium-sized dogs who spend a lot of time outside are also at an increased risk of infections and therefore need a strong immune system. Royal Canin Medium Puppy dry dog food caters to the unique characteristics of growing dogs of medium-sized breeds (11 - 25kg) from 2 months: Harmonious growth: high energy contents and an increased proportion of protein (32%) optimally cater for the dog's requirements in the growth period when digestive capacity is still small Strengthened immune system: a synergistic complex of antioxidants (taurine, lutein, vitamins E and A) as well as mannan-oligosaccharides help strengthen the young body's natural defenses Joint health: a balanced ratio of calcium and phosphorus supports harmonious skeleton growth and healthy teeth Optimal kibble size: special kibble size, shape and structure for easy chewing In the first few months of life, the digestive system of medium-sized puppies is very sensitive. Their digestive capacity develops only slowly and certain nutrients such as starch may only be digested in small quantities. Royal Canin Medium Puppy contains prebiotics such as fructo-oligosaccharides, mannan-oligosaccharides and dried beet shavings and thus ensures optimal digestion and efficient absorption of nutrients.

item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kalb Truthahn (Veal Turkey) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat German precision. Premium proteins. Ten individual sticks. Perfecto Cat Catsticks Mit Kalb Truthahn are premium German cat treat sticks made with veal and turkey — two of the most refined, lean, and palatable proteins available in the premium cat treat category. Each pack contains 10 individually portioned sticks of approximately 5g each — the perfect format for daily treating, training, and bonding, with the precise portion control that prevents overfeeding. Veal is the most tender, delicate expression of beef — lean, mild, and exceptionally digestible. Turkey is the leanest of the poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that cats find consistently appealing. Together, they create a dual-protein stick treat that is more nutritionally complete and more palatably interesting than single-protein alternatives — in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats love to hold, chew, and devour. German quality. Premium proteins. Ten sticks per pack. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Veal Turkey Is The Best Choice Veal — The Most Tender Beef Protein — Veal is young beef — the most tender, delicate, and mildly flavored expression of beef protein, with exceptional digestibility and a refined flavor that cats find highly appealing. Turkey — The Leanest Poultry — Turkey is the leanest of the common poultry proteins — rich in tryptophan, B vitamins, and the clean, mild flavor that complements veal's delicate richness. Dual Premium Protein — Veal and turkey together provide a broader amino acid profile and more complete nutritional coverage than single-protein stick treats. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control, no measuring, no waste, no overfeeding. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats can hold between their paws and chew — engaging the natural holding and chewing behaviors that make stick treats one of the most satisfying treat formats. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand known for quality ingredients and precise formulation — the European quality standard applied to cat treats. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both veal and turkey are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. Chewy Texture — Satisfying chewing engagement that extends the treat experience and provides mild dental benefit. Novel Protein Variety — Veal is genuinely rare in cat treats — a novel protein that provides variety for cats who eat primarily chicken or seafood-based food. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack showing the individual portions.) Product Details Features The Catstick Format — Why Sticks Work The cat stick format is one of the most engaging treat formats available — and it works because it aligns with natural feline feeding behaviors: Natural holding behavior: Cats in the wild hold prey with their front paws while eating — the stick format mimics this behavior, allowing cats to hold the stick between their paws and chew from one end. This holding and chewing behavior is deeply satisfying for cats — more engaging than simply eating a soft treat from a bowl. Chewing engagement: The firm, chewy texture of cat sticks requires sustained chewing — engaging the jaw muscles and providing a more physically satisfying treat experience than soft or liquid treats. Extended eating time: The chewing required for a stick treat extends the duration of the treat experience — cats spend more time engaged with the treat, increasing the perceived value and satisfaction. Mild dental benefit: The chewing action provides mild mechanical cleaning of tooth surfaces — a small but meaningful dental hygiene benefit. Portion clarity: Each stick is a clearly defined, individual portion — making it easy to control daily treat intake without measuring or estimating. Veal — The Most Refined Beef Protein Veal is the defining premium ingredient of this formula — and its inclusion reflects Perfecto Cat's commitment to quality over cost: What veal is: Veal is meat from young cattle — typically calves under 6 months of age. The youth of the animal produces meat that is: More tender — Less developed muscle fiber creates a softer, more delicate texture More mildly flavored — The flavor is more delicate and refined than mature beef — less gamey, less assertive, more palatable to cats with sensitive palates More digestible — The less developed muscle fiber and lower connective tissue content of veal makes it more easily digestible than mature beef Leaner — Veal is naturally leaner than mature beef — providing high-quality protein without excessive fat Nutritional profile of veal: Complete protein — All essential amino acids in proportions that closely match feline requirements Heme iron — Supporti

Carding Order – Along the direction of fur growth, brush your pet’s fur from neck to shoulder, and then to chest, waist, abdomen, abdomen, rear quarters, and then to the head, the last are legs and tail. Carding Skill – Along the direction of fur growth, gently move your brush. Especially for some long fur pets, you need to brush layered fur. Dog Brush Cat Brush- Slicker Pet Grooming Brush- Shedding Grooming Tools NAOMI Dog Brushes Combs Collection from EGYPUPPY : Easy To Use Grooming Products for Dogs Basic grooming for dogs goes a long way in helping overall health and wellness. Something that you can do quite easily at home is brushing your pet every day. This distributes natural oils across the coat and makes it look well-kept and glossy. Brushing also encourages blood circulation which contributes to the health of the skin and coat. For shedding season, a dog deshedder brush is a must. You can catch shed hair right at the source so there is much less around the house and on your furniture. Just pick a dog brush or comb that is ideal for daily brushing sessions at home. Remember that dogs can sense it if you’re restless or anxious to be done and will probably reflect this in their behavior. So, choose a time when you are relaxed and don’t have to rush off to the next task. Then remember to keep everything you need ready so you don’t have to interrupt the session. It’s important to get your dog to enjoy the session so they come to you voluntarily for it – the more you force them, the more resistant they will be. Keep your sessions short maybe a maximum of 15-20 minutes. When done right this is a great way to strengthen the bond you have with your pet. It’s something that makes them feel good just as well. If your space is too small to give your dog a bath comfortably or the weather doesn’t cooperate, book him or her in for an appointment at any of our branches EGYPUPPY . item.g:title: Virbac Kidney Support Dog Food K1 – For Dogs with Kidney Disease 3KG
item.g:description: VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is a complete and balanced dry food for dogs with temporary or chronic kidney disease. It’s expertly formulated to support your dog’s kidney function while helping them to maintain optimal body condition. Ideal nutrient ratios for dogs with kidney disease VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains a restricted amount of high-quality proteins (20.5%) to preserve lean muscle mass without adding additional strain on the kidneys. This is balanced with high energy density to give your dog the energy they need from smaller portions – ideal for periods of appetite loss. Low in phosphorous to preserve kidney function Phosphorus is an essential mineral, but in dogs with compromised kidney health they are not able to filter it effectively. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support contains low levels of phosphorus (0.4%) to protect your dog’s kidney function. It also features chitosan, an ingredient that binds to phosphorus and reduces levels in the body. Reduces the risk of secondary health issues VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support helps to limit the risk of other health conditions associated with kidney disease. It contains: • Balanced calcium and phosphorus to protect against secondary hyperparathyroidism. • Adapted protein level to reduce production of uraemic toxins whilst maintaining body condition. • Calcium carbonate to help limit the risk of metabolic acidosis. Supportive nutrients for overall health and wellbeing VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support features a blend of ingredients designed to support your dog’s overall wellbeing: • Vitamin E is an antioxidant that helps to limit oxidative stress on the kidneys and other organs. • Omega-3 fatty acids support skin and coat health and help to limit inflammation. • Chondroitin sulphate helps to support joint cartilage health. • Chitosan optimises the breakdown and absorption of chondroitin. VETERINARY HPM® K1 Kidney Support is an ideal dog food for kidney disease in both adult and senior dogs, and is also suitable for dogs with chronic hepatic (liver) disease. Rich in naturally tasty, high-quality animal ingredients to help with palatability.

item.g:title: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean & Tidy
item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean Tidy Protect your pet from fleas and ticks with the Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Clean Tidy. This essential grooming tool features ultra-fine teeth specifically designed to catch and remove fleas, flea eggs, ticks, and debris from your pet's coat. Safe, chemical-free, and effective, this flea comb is a must-have for any pet owner committed to keeping their furry friend comfortable and pest-free. Why Nunbell Pet Flea Comb Is The Best Choice Fine-Tooth Design : Ultra-close teeth spacing effectively traps fleas, flea eggs, and ticks Chemical-Free Solution : Safe, natural flea removal without harsh chemicals or pesticides Early Detection : Helps you spot flea infestations before they become serious problems Gentle Safe : Smooth, rounded teeth won't scratch or irritate your pet's skin Multi-Purpose : Also removes dirt, debris, and loose fur while checking for parasites Product Details Features At petfast.shop, we understand that fleas and ticks are more than just a nuisance—they can cause serious health issues for your pet and infest your home. The Nunbell Pet Flea Comb provides a safe, effective way to detect and remove these parasites without exposing your pet to chemicals. The ultra-fine teeth are precisely spaced to catch even the smallest fleas and their eggs, making this an essential tool for flea prevention and control. Key Features: Ultra-fine, closely-spaced metal teeth Smooth, rounded tips prevent skin irritation Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip Durable stainless steel or high-quality metal construction Suitable for dogs and cats of all sizes Works on all coat types and lengths Easy to clean between uses Lightweight and easy to maneuver Chemical-free, safe for puppies and kittens Essential for flea monitoring and removal Usage Guide Flea Detection Suitable For: Dogs and cats of all sizes and coat types Ideal For: Flea detection, flea removal, tick removal, parasite monitoring How to Use: Prepare Your Pet : Ensure your pet is calm and comfortable Start at the Head : Begin combing from the head, working toward the tail Comb Thoroughly : Work through the entire coat in small sections, paying special attention to warm areas where fleas congregate Check the Comb : After each stroke, examine the comb for fleas, flea dirt, or eggs Dip in Water : Keep a bowl of soapy water nearby to dip the comb and drown captured fleas Focus on Hot Spots : Pay extra attention to neck, ears, armpits, groin, and base of tail Repeat Regularly : Use daily during infestations, weekly for prevention Key Areas to Check: Fleas prefer warm, protected areas on your pet's body: Around the neck and collar area Behind and inside the ears Under the front legs (armpits) Groin and belly area Base of the tail and lower back Between the toes Identifying Flea Infestation: What to Look For: Live Fleas : Small, dark brown insects that move quickly Flea Dirt : Black specks (flea feces) that turn red when wet Flea Eggs : Tiny white or translucent oval specks Excessive Scratching : Your pet scratching more than usual Red, Irritated Skin : Flea bites cause inflammation Hair Loss : From excessive scratching and biting Flea Dirt Test: Place suspected flea dirt on a white paper towel and add a drop of water. If it turns reddish-brown, it's flea feces (digested blood). Flea Control Best Practices: Regular Combing Schedule: During Infestation : Daily combing until fleas are eliminated Prevention : 2-3 times per week during flea season Year-Round Monitoring : Weekly checks even in winter Complete Flea Control Program: Treat Your Pet : Use flea comb plus veterinarian-recommended flea treatment Treat Your Home : Vacuum thoroughly, wash bedding, treat carpets and furniture Treat Outdoor Areas : Address yard and outdoor spaces where your pet spends time Prevent Re-Infestation : Maintain regular combing and preventive treatments Care Maintenance: Clean the comb after each use Remove trapped fleas and debris Wash with hot, soapy water Disinfect regularly with pet-safe cleaner Dry thoroughly before storing Store in a clean, dry location Replace if teeth become bent or damaged DB34968

item.g:description: VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On for Dogs Small (4–10 kg) Small breeds are just as vulnerable to fleas and ticks as larger dogs, but they require treatments precisely dosed for their size. VIRBAC Effitix Spot-On Small is formulated for dogs weighing between 4 and 10 kg, providing a correctly measured monthly topical treatment that protects without overexposure. The combination of permethrin and fipronil works on the skin and coat to kill fleas, ticks, and lice, and to repel biting insects. For small dogs that spend time in gardens, parks, or with other animals, monthly Effitix application builds a reliable protective barrier that lasts through an entire month. Effitix is particularly convenient for owners who find oral tablet administration challenging with smaller, less cooperative dogs. Product Features Designed for small dogs weighing 4 to 10 kg Monthly spot-on application for sustained parasite control Kills fleas, ticks, and lice on contact Repels biting flies and sand flies Dual-action formula: permethrin and fipronil Correctly dosed for small dog body weight Protection lasts up to 4 weeks Trusted VIRBAC veterinary product Active Ingredients Permethrin and Fipronil – dual-action ectoparasitic protection. How to Apply Part the fur to expose the skin at the back of the neck, between the shoulder blades. Apply the entire contents of the pipette directly to the skin. Avoid contact with the dog's eyes or mouth. Keep children away until the site is dry. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Variant Application Interval 4 - 10 kg Effitix Small Every 4 weeks Not for use on cats. Do not bathe the dog for at least 48 hours before or after application for maximum efficacy. Store in original packaging below 25°C. item.g:title: Perfecto Cat Feine Knabber Kissen Anti Hairball 50g
item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Feine Knabber Kissen Anti Hairball (Fine Nibble Cushions Anti Hairball) | 50g | Functional Cat Treat The treat that solves the hairball problem. Perfecto Cat Feine Knabber Kissen Anti Hairball are German functional cat treats in the distinctive pillow/cushion format — a crunchy outer shell with a soft, functional filling — specifically formulated to reduce hairball formation through dietary fiber and targeted ingredients that support smooth gut transit. Hairballs are one of the most common and frustrating feline health issues — and the most effective long-term solution is not occasional laxative paste, but consistent daily dietary fiber that keeps the digestive system moving smoothly enough to pass ingested hair before it accumulates into a hairball. Perfecto Cat delivers this daily fiber support in the treat format that cats actually want to eat — the satisfying crunch of the pillow shell, the soft filling inside, and the German quality that ensures consistent, reliable formulation. 50g per pack — the daily functional treat that prevents the problem before it starts. Why Perfecto Cat Anti Hairball Nibble Cushions Is The Best Choice Anti Hairball Function — Specifically formulated to reduce hairball formation — dietary fiber and targeted ingredients that support smooth gut transit and help ingested hair pass through the digestive system before accumulating. Pillow/Cushion Format — The distinctive "Knabber Kissen" format — a crunchy outer shell with a soft functional filling — providing textural variety and the satisfying crunch that cats find engaging. Daily Prevention vs. Occasional Treatment — Daily dietary fiber from a treat cats want to eat is more effective than occasional laxative paste — consistent gut transit support prevents hairball formation rather than treating it after the fact. Dietary Fiber — The Natural Hairball Solution — Dietary fiber regulates gut transit speed and adds bulk to the stool — helping ingested hair move through the digestive system smoothly rather than accumulating in the stomach. Crunchy Texture — Dental Benefit — The crunchy outer shell provides meaningful mechanical dental cleaning — more effective than soft treats for reducing plaque and tartar buildup. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards and precise functional formulation. 50g Pack — A generous pack size that provides multiple daily servings — the daily treat routine that makes consistent hairball prevention easy. Accessible Price Point — The most accessible functional treat in the Perfecto Cat range — daily hairball prevention without premium treat pricing. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat eating the pillow-shaped treats from a bowl, or flat-lay of the treats showing the distinctive cushion shape and the Perfecto Cat Anti Hairball branding.) Product Details Features Understanding Hairballs — The Problem This Treat Solves Hairballs (trichobezoars) are one of the most common feline health issues — and understanding how they form explains why daily dietary fiber is the most effective prevention strategy: How hairballs form: Grooming — Cats spend 30–50% of their waking hours grooming — using their barbed tongue to remove loose hair from their coat Ingestion — The backward-facing barbs on the cat's tongue make it impossible to spit out ingested hair — it is swallowed with every grooming stroke Accumulation — In a healthy digestive system with adequate gut transit, ingested hair passes through the stomach and intestines and is expelled in the stool. When gut transit is too slow or fiber intake is insufficient, hair accumulates in the stomach rather than passing through. Hairball formation — Accumulated hair mixes with stomach mucus and partially digested food to form a compacted mass — the hairball Vomiting — When the hairball becomes large enough to cause discomfort, the cat vomits it up — the characteristic cylindrical, mucus-coated mass Why hairballs are a problem: Discomfort — The accumulation of hair in the stomach causes nausea and discomfort before vomiting Vomiting frequency — Frequent hairball vomiting is distressing for both cat and owner Obstruction risk — In severe cases, hairballs can cause intestinal obstruction — a potentially life-threatening condition requiring veterinary intervention Appetite suppression — Cats with significant hairball accumulation often show reduced appetite The dietary fiber solution: Dietary fiber is the most effective long-term hairball prevention strategy because it addresses the root cause — inadequate gut transit — rather than the symptom: Soluble fiber — Forms a gel in the digestive tract that lubricates the passage of hair through the intestines Insoluble fiber — Adds bulk to the stool and increases gut transit speed — moving ingested hair through the system before it can accumulate Prebiotic effect — Dietary fiber feeds beneficial gut bacteria that support healthy digestive function and reg

item.g:description: Nunbell Pet Slicker Brush Give your pet the grooming care they deserve. This slicker brush is designed to remove loose fur, detangle gently and leave their coat smooth — making grooming less of a chore and more of a bonding moment. Why Nunbell Pet Slicker Brush Is The Best Choice Removes loose hair and under-coat efficiently, helping to reduce shedding around your home. Fine curved metal pins and a cushioned pad are built for comfort and gentle grooming even for pets with sensitive skin. Ergonomic handle gives you a firm, comfortable grip — making grooming sessions smoother for both you and your pet. Suitable for both dogs and cats, in a variety of coat types (from short-to-medium to longer fur) — offering versatility. Excellent value: a single high-quality brush can reduce grooming time, save on replacements and improve coat health. Product Details Features This slicker brush is designed with real homes and real pets in mind: Material / Build: Fine metal pins mounted in a cushioned pad backing; robust plastic/ergonomic handle. Best For: Pets that shed, have light tangles, or owners wanting to maintain coat quality with regular brushing. Special Features: The cushioned pad helps pins adapt to body contours, minimizing tug-on the skin. Allows daily or regular brushing without causing discomfort, helping build grooming habit. Helps distribute natural oils through the coat, promoting shine and healthy skin. Usage Cases: Weekly grooming sessions to reduce fur around sofas and floors. Before or after walks/outings to remove loose hair or light mats. Ideal for multi-pet households needing one reliable grooming tool. Specifications Use Feature Detail Size Variant Available in small / medium / large (check listing) Suitable For Dogs cats with short to medium or longer coats Materials Metal pins + cushioned pad + ergonomic handle Primary Benefits Reduces shedding, detangles, smooths coat Typical Frequency Brushing ~2-3 times per week (or as needed) How to use: Choose the size variant of the brush that best matches your pet’s size and coat length. Begin in a calm setting — hold the brush, let your pet sniff it and get comfortable. Brush gently in the direction of hair-growth, focusing on prone-to-tangle areas (behind ears, under legs, tail base). Use slow, consistent strokes; if you feel resistance, lift and reposition rather than forcing. After brushing, remove collected hair from the brush, check for bent pins or damage, and store the brush in a dry place.

item.g:title: Revolution Topical Solution for Dogs, 20.1-40 lbs - 1 Pipette(Red Box)
item.g:description: Revolution is a medication that is applied directly on your furry friend's skin to protect them from biting critters. When applied every 30 days, Revolution protects against heartworms, fleas, and ear mites. It's also effective in preventing and treating roundworms and hookworms in kittens and sarcoptic mange and American dog tick infestations in puppies. Uses Revolution is formulated to kill adult fleas and prevents flea eggs from hatching for one month. It is also indicated for the prevention and control of flea infestations, prevention of heartworm disease caused by Dirofilaria immitis, and the treatment and control of ear mite infestations. Revolution is also indicated for the treatment and control of sarcoptic mange and for the control of tick infestations due to Dermacentor variabilis. Possible Side Effects In safety studies, Revolution was administered at 1, 3, 5, and 10 times the recommended dose to sixweek-old puppies, and no adverse reactions were observed. When tested for oral ingestion at the recommended topical dose in 5 to 8-month-old beagles, no adverse reactions were observed. In a topical safety study conducted with avermectinsensitive collies at 1, 3 and 5 times the recommended dose of Revolution, salivation was observed in all treatment groups. Revolution also was administered at 3 times the recommended dose to heartworm infected dogs, and no adverse effects were observed. If side effects do occur, please contact your veterinarian immediately. Drug Food Interactions Talk to your veterinarian about any other drugs your dog is taking before starting this medication. Precautions Prior to administration of Revolution, dogs should be tested for existing heartworm infections. At the discretion of the veterinarian, infected dogs should be treated to remove adult heartworms. Revolution is not effective against adult D. immitis and, while the number of circulating microfilariae may decrease following treatment, Revolution is not effective for microfilariae clearance. Hypersensitivity reactions have not been observed in dogs with patent heartworm infections administered three times the recommended dose of Revolution. Higher doses were not tested. For use in animals only. Keep out of reach of children. " Made in USA " ( Zoetis )

Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O Morsels Benefits: High moisture content increases urine dilution. Helps dissolve all types of struvite stones. Helps lower the concentration of ions contributing to crystal formation. More About Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O Morsels: Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O Morsels in Gravy is specially formulated with the nutritional needs of your adult cat in mind and is available in boxes of 12x 85g pouches. Suitable for cats with urinary health concerns, Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O Morsels in Gravy helps to dissolve different types of struvite stones that form in the bladder. This food has a high moisture content to help your cat produce an increased amount of diluted urine. In the development of Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O, RSS (Relative Super Saturation) methodology is utilized to assist in the reduced concentration of ions that play a part in the formation of crystals. As part of the Royal Canin Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only given to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. To cater to the individual preferences of each cat, Royal Canin Urinary Feline S/O is also available as a soft and tasty loaf or as dry food with crunchy and tasty kibble. item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Dissolution& Prevention 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Dissolution Prevention | 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food Dissolve existing struvite. Prevent recurrence. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution Prevention is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the active dissolution of struvite crystals and uroliths, and the long-term prevention of struvite recurrence. Where the Virbac HPM Urinary WIB formula provides balanced dual protection against both struvite and calcium oxalate crystals, the Dissolution Prevention formula is a struvite-targeted clinical diet — more aggressively formulated for urine acidification and mineral restriction to actively dissolve existing struvite deposits and prevent new struvite formation. This is the formula prescribed when struvite crystals have been confirmed by urinalysis or imaging — the clinical diet that works actively to resolve the existing crystal burden while simultaneously preventing recurrence. Struvite is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — and dietary dissolution is the preferred first-line treatment for struvite uroliths, avoiding the need for surgical removal in most cases. 1.5kg — the struvite dissolution and prevention diet that resolves the problem and keeps it resolved. Why Virbac HPM Cat Urology Dissolution Prevention Is The Best Choice Active Struvite Dissolution — Formulated to actively dissolve existing struvite crystals and uroliths through urine acidification and mineral restriction — the dietary alternative to surgical urolith removal. Struvite Prevention — Maintains the urinary environment that prevents new struvite crystal formation after dissolution is complete — for long-term recurrence prevention. Urine Acidification — Targets a urine pH that dissolves struvite (which requires alkaline conditions to form and acidic conditions to dissolve) — the primary mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution. Magnesium Phosphorus Restriction — Struvite is composed of magnesium ammonium phosphate — restricting these minerals reduces the substrate available for crystal formation. High Moisture Encouragement — Increasing urine volume dilutes mineral concentrations and flushes the urinary tract — supporting both dissolution and prevention. Struvite-Confirmed Indication — The appropriate choice when struvite crystals have been confirmed by veterinary urinalysis or imaging — more targeted than the WIB formula for confirmed struvite cases. Dissolution Without Surgery — Dietary struvite dissolution avoids the need for surgical cystotomy in most cases — a significant benefit for cat owners and cats alike. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently for dissolution to occur — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 1.5kg — The ongoing management size for the dissolution and prevention program. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Dissolution Prevention bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, healthy cat — communicating the urinary health the clinical diet restores.) Product Details Features Struvite — The Most Common Feline Urinary Crystal Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate, MgNH₄PO₄·6H₂O) is the most common urinary crystal type in cats — accounting for approximately 40–50% of feline uroliths submitted for analysis. Understanding struvite formation and dissolution explains why the Dissolution Prevention formula works: How struvite forms: Struvite crystals form when urine contains: Alkaline pH (>7.0) — Struvite is insoluble in alkaline urine and precipitates readily High magnesium concentration — Magnesium is a structural component of struvite High ammonium concentration — Ammonium (from protein metabolism) is a structural component of struvite High phosphate concentration — Phosphate is a structural component of struvite Concentrated urine — High urine specific gravity increases the concentration of all crystal-forming minerals Risk factors for struvite formation: Urinary tract infection (UTI) — Urease-producing bacteria alkalinize urine and increase ammonium — the most common cause of struvite in dogs (less common in cats) Alkaline diet — High-carbohydrate, plant-protein-heavy diets tend to alkalinize urine Concentrated urine — Inadequate water intake Female cats — Wider urethra allows bacteria to ascend more easily (UTI-associated struvite) How struvite dissolves: Struvite is soluble in acidic urine — reducing urine pH below 6.5 causes existing struvite crystals to dissolve. This is the mechanism of dietary struvite dissolution: The Dissolution Prevention diet acidifies urine to pH 6.0–6.5 Existing struvite crystals dissolve in the acidic urine Dissolved minerals are excreted in the urine The crystal burden is progressively reduced over 4–12 weeks The diet is continued to prevent recurrence The Dissolution Prevention Formula — Clinical Mechanism Urine acid

item.g:title: Bravecto MSD 10-20Kg Adult Dog Flea & Tick Treatment - 1 Tablet
item.g:description: 12 weeks of powerful protection in one convenient chew. Bravecto is a revolutionary flea and tick treatment that provides 3 full months of continuous protection for dogs weighing 10-20kg. This prescription-strength, veterinarian-recommended chewable tablet kills fleas, ticks, and mites quickly and effectively, preventing infestations and protecting your dog from dangerous tick-borne diseases—all with just one dose every 12 weeks. With a palatable beef-flavored chew that dogs love and proven efficacy trusted by veterinarians worldwide, Bravecto makes parasite protection simple, effective, and stress-free. Because your dog deserves the best protection available. Why Bravecto Is The Best Choice 12 Weeks Protection: One chew provides 3 full months of continuous flea and tick protection. Kills Fleas Fast: Starts killing fleas within 2 hours and kills 100% within 12 hours. Broad Spectrum: Effective against fleas, ticks (multiple species), and mites. Prevents Infestations: Kills fleas before they can lay eggs, breaking the life cycle. Tick-Borne Disease Protection: Kills ticks before they can transmit diseases. Palatable Chew: Beef-flavored tablet dogs willingly eat. Veterinarian Recommended: Trusted by vets worldwide for efficacy and safety. Convenient Dosing: Only 4 doses per year instead of monthly treatments. Product Details Features Bravecto (Fluralaner) is a prescription flea and tick treatment that provides industry-leading 12-week protection, making it the most convenient and effective parasite control available for dogs. Revolutionary 12-Week Protection Unlike monthly treatments that require remembering to dose every 4 weeks, Bravecto provides 3 full months of continuous protection with a single dose. This means only 4 treatments per year, fewer chances to forget a dose, consistent protection without gaps, less stress for you and your dog, and better compliance for year-round protection. Set it and forget it for 12 weeks. Fast-Acting Flea Control Bravecto works incredibly fast to eliminate flea infestations. It starts killing fleas within 2 hours of administration, kills 100% of fleas within 12 hours, continues killing new fleas for 12 weeks, prevents flea eggs from being laid, and breaks the flea life cycle. Your dog gets rapid relief from flea bites and itching. Comprehensive Tick Protection Ticks are more than just annoying—they transmit serious diseases. Bravecto kills multiple tick species including black-legged ticks (Lyme disease), American dog ticks (Rocky Mountain spotted fever), brown dog ticks, lone star ticks, and Asian longhorned ticks. Kills ticks before they can transmit diseases (within 12 hours). Provides continuous 12-week protection against new tick infestations. Protect your dog from dangerous tick-borne illnesses. Mite Control Bravecto also treats and controls mite infestations including Demodex mites (demodectic mange) and Sarcoptes mites (sarcoptic mange). One treatment addresses multiple parasite threats. How Bravecto Works Bravecto contains fluralaner, a powerful insecticide and acaricide that works systemically. After your dog eats the chew, fluralaner is absorbed into the bloodstream, distributed throughout the body, and remains at effective levels for 12 weeks. When fleas or ticks bite your dog, they ingest fluralaner, which attacks their nervous system, causing paralysis and death. Fleas and ticks are killed before they can reproduce or transmit diseases. Palatable Beef-Flavored Chew Unlike topical treatments that can be messy or difficult to apply, Bravecto is a tasty chew that most dogs eat willingly. The beef flavor makes administration easy, no mess or residue on fur, no waiting period before petting or swimming, and dogs actually enjoy taking their medicine. Treatment time becomes treat time. Veterinarian Recommended Bravecto is trusted by veterinarians worldwide for its proven efficacy and safety profile, extensive clinical testing, consistent results, and superior convenience. When your vet recommends flea and tick protection, Bravecto is often the first choice. Safe Effective Bravecto has been extensively tested and proven safe when used as directed. It's suitable for dogs 6 months and older weighing 10-20kg, safe for breeding, pregnant, and lactating dogs, and compatible with most other medications. Always consult your veterinarian before use. Dosage Administration Dosing Information: Weight Range: 10-20kg (22-44 lbs) Dosage: One chewable tablet Frequency: Every 12 weeks (4 times per year) Administration: Give with or without food Administration Instructions: Weigh your dog: Ensure your dog weighs between 10-20kg Give one tablet: Offer the chew directly to your dog Ensure consumption: Watch to make sure your dog eats the entire chew If not eaten: Can be given with food or hidden in treat Mark calendar: Note the date and set reminder for 12 weeks later Repeat every 12 weeks: Continue year-round for best protection Important Notes: Prescription required—consult your vet

item.g:title: Virbac EPIOTIC for Dog & Cat SIS 125ML VBI
item.g:description: The veterinary standard for ear hygiene. Virbac Epiotic is the world's most widely used veterinary ear cleaning solution — a clinically proven, non-irritating ear cleaner specifically formulated to clean, dry, deodorize, and maintain the healthy ear environment of dogs and cats. Epiotic is not a treatment for ear infections — it is the preventive and maintenance ear cleaner that removes the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for otitis externa (ear infection) to develop. Regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the single most effective preventive measure for otitis externa — the most common ear condition in dogs and one of the most frequent reasons for veterinary consultation. Epiotic's unique formulation combines salicylic acid (ceruminolytic — dissolves ear wax), a monosaccharide solution (creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal), and EDTA-Tris (antimicrobial potentiator) — working together to clean the ear canal, reduce moisture, acidify the ear environment, and create conditions unfavorable for bacterial and yeast growth. Gentle enough for regular weekly use. Effective enough to be the ear cleaner that veterinary dermatologists recommend worldwide. 125ml — the ear hygiene solution that prevents the problem before it starts. Why Virbac Epiotic Is The Best Choice The World's Most Widely Used Veterinary Ear Cleaner — Epiotic is the ear cleaning solution that veterinary dermatologists recommend and prescribe more than any other — the clinical gold standard for ear hygiene in dogs and cats. Ceruminolytic Action — Salicylic acid dissolves and loosens ear wax (cerumen) — allowing it to be flushed out of the ear canal rather than accumulating and creating a substrate for infection. Drying Effect — The monosaccharide solution creates an osmotic environment that draws moisture from the ear canal — reducing the humidity that bacteria and yeast require to thrive. Acidifying Effect — Epiotic acidifies the ear canal environment — creating a pH that is unfavorable for the growth of the bacteria and yeast most commonly responsible for otitis externa. EDTA-Tris — Antimicrobial Potentiator — Enhances the antimicrobial effect of the acidified environment — disrupting bacterial cell walls and increasing susceptibility to the ear's natural defenses. Non-Irritating — Gentle enough for regular weekly use — does not irritate the sensitive skin of the ear canal even with frequent application. Deodorizing — Removes the organic debris and microbial metabolites that produce the characteristic unpleasant odor of dirty or infected ears. Otitis Prevention — Regular use prevents the wax accumulation, moisture retention, and pH shift that create the conditions for otitis externa to develop. For Dogs Cats — Formulated for use in both species — a versatile veterinary ear cleaner for multi-pet households. Virbac — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. 125ml — A practical size for regular maintenance ear cleaning. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a dog or cat having its ears cleaned with Epiotic — communicating the ease and gentleness of the cleaning process — or flat-lay of the Epiotic bottle with the clinical branding prominent.) Product Details Features Understanding Otitis Externa — The Problem Epiotic Prevents Otitis externa (inflammation and infection of the external ear canal) is one of the most common conditions in dogs — accounting for approximately 10–20% of all veterinary consultations. Understanding how otitis develops explains why regular ear cleaning with Epiotic is the most effective preventive measure: The ear canal environment: The canine and feline ear canal is L-shaped — with a vertical canal and a horizontal canal leading to the eardrum. This anatomy: Traps moisture, wax, and debris — particularly in dogs with floppy ears or narrow canals Creates a warm, dark, humid environment — ideal for bacterial and yeast growth Makes self-cleaning difficult — the dog cannot effectively remove accumulated debris The otitis development cascade: Predisposing factors — Floppy ears, narrow canals, excessive hair in the canal, swimming, allergies, or hormonal disorders create conditions that favor otitis Primary factors — Allergies (the most common), foreign bodies, parasites (ear mites), or keratinization disorders initiate the inflammatory process Secondary factors — Bacteria ( Staphylococcus , Pseudomonas ) and yeast ( Malassezia ) colonize the inflamed ear canal — converting inflammation into infection Perpetuating factors — Chronic changes to the ear canal (thickening, stenosis, calcification) make the condition self-perpetuating Where Epiotic intervenes: Epiotic intervenes at the earliest stage — removing the wax, debris, and moisture that create the conditions for the otitis cascade to begin. Virbac HPM Dog Digestive Support is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry dog food specifically formulated to support dogs with digestive disorders — including sensitive stomach, food intolerance, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), acute and chronic diarrhea, and malabsorption conditions. Virbac HPM (Health Prescription Management) is the veterinary nutrition line from Virbac — one of the world's leading animal health companies, with over 50 years of veterinary expertise — and the Digestive Support formula reflects the same scientific rigor that Virbac applies to its pharmaceutical and veterinary products. This is not a standard commercial dog food — it is a clinical diet developed in collaboration with veterinary nutritionists and gastroenterologists, formulated to the precise nutritional specifications that dogs with compromised digestive systems require. Highly digestible proteins. Prebiotic fiber. Controlled fat. Optimal nutrient absorption. Everything a dog with digestive challenges needs — in a complete, balanced, veterinary-grade dry food. 1.5kg — the clinical diet that makes a measurable difference. Why Virbac HPM Dog Digestive Support Is The Best Choice Veterinary Clinical Nutrition — Formulated by Virbac's veterinary nutritionists specifically for dogs with digestive disorders — not a general "sensitive stomach" commercial food, but a genuine clinical diet. Highly Digestible Proteins — Selected protein sources with high digestibility coefficients — maximizing nutrient absorption while minimizing the digestive load on a compromised gastrointestinal system. Prebiotic Fiber — Specific dietary fiber blend that feeds beneficial gut bacteria, supports healthy gut microbiome composition, and regulates gut transit — addressing the root cause of many digestive disorders. Controlled Fat Content — Reduced and carefully controlled fat content — fat is the most difficult macronutrient to digest, and reducing fat load significantly reduces digestive stress in dogs with compromised fat absorption. Optimal Nutrient Absorption — The formula is designed to maximize the absorption of nutrients even in dogs with compromised intestinal function — ensuring adequate nutrition despite reduced absorptive capacity. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — the same scientific rigor applied to Virbac's pharmaceutical products, applied to clinical nutrition. Addresses Multiple Digestive Conditions — Suitable for sensitive stomach, food intolerance, IBD, acute diarrhea, chronic diarrhea, and malabsorption — a versatile clinical diet for the full spectrum of canine digestive disorders. Complete Balanced — Provides complete and balanced nutrition for adult dogs — the dog receives all essential nutrients despite the clinical formulation. Veterinarian Recommended — Developed in collaboration with veterinary gastroenterologists — the clinical diet that veterinarians trust and recommend. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Digestive Support bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a healthy, comfortable dog eating from a bowl of the Virbac HPM kibble.) Product Details Features Virbac HPM — The Veterinary Nutrition Standard Virbac is one of the world's leading animal health companies — founded in France in 1968, with operations in over 100 countries and a portfolio spanning pharmaceuticals, vaccines, diagnostics, and clinical nutrition. The HPM (Health Prescription Management) line represents Virbac's application of its pharmaceutical-grade scientific rigor to pet nutrition — clinical diets developed by veterinary specialists, formulated to precise nutritional specifications, and validated through clinical research. The HPM Digestive Support formula is not a marketing-driven "sensitive stomach" product — it is a genuine clinical diet developed in collaboration with veterinary gastroenterologists and nutritionists, formulated to address the specific nutritional requirements of dogs with compromised digestive function. Understanding Canine Digestive Disorders The Virbac HPM Digestive Support formula is designed to address a spectrum of canine digestive conditions: Sensitive stomach: Dogs with sensitive stomachs react to standard commercial foods with intermittent digestive upset — loose stools, vomiting, flatulence, or reduced appetite. The highly digestible, controlled-fat formula reduces the digestive load that triggers these reactions. Food intolerance: Food intolerance (distinct from food allergy) occurs when a dog's digestive system cannot properly process specific ingredients — typically certain proteins, fats, or carbohydrates. The carefully selected, highly digestible ingredients in the Digestive Support formula minimize the risk of intolerance reactions.
