item.g:title: Virbac Cat Advanced Kidney & Joint
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Advanced Kidney Joint The senior cat clinical diet that addresses both conditions at once. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney Joint is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated for the two most prevalent and frequently co-occurring conditions in senior cats — chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis). These conditions are not coincidental companions — they share common risk factors, common inflammatory mechanisms, and common patient demographics. The senior cat who develops CKD is the same cat who develops joint disease — and managing one condition while ignoring the other produces incomplete clinical outcomes. Virbac HPM addresses both simultaneously through a precisely calibrated nutritional strategy that navigates the most challenging tension in feline clinical nutrition: kidney diets require controlled protein to reduce renal workload, but joint disease requires adequate protein to maintain the lean muscle mass that supports joint function and mobility. Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney Joint resolves this tension through high-quality, highly digestible protein at precisely controlled levels — providing adequate amino acids for muscle maintenance while minimizing the uremic toxin load on compromised kidneys. Available in 400g (trial size) and 1.5kg. Why Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney Joint Is The Best Choice Dual Clinical Indication — Simultaneously addresses chronic kidney disease (CKD) and joint disease (osteoarthritis) — the two most prevalent co-occurring conditions in senior cats. Controlled High-Quality Protein — The most clinically precise aspect of the formula — protein is controlled to reduce renal workload while remaining adequate for lean muscle maintenance that supports joint function. Phosphorus Restriction — Reduced phosphorus is the single most important dietary intervention for slowing CKD progression — the Virbac HPM formula provides clinically appropriate phosphorus restriction. Omega-3 (EPA DHA) — Dual Benefit — Omega-3 fatty acids provide anti-inflammatory benefit for both kidney disease (reducing renal inflammation) and joint disease (reducing synovial inflammation and cartilage degradation). Joint Support Nutrients — Glucosamine and chondroitin sulfate supporting cartilage integrity and synovial fluid quality — the structural joint support nutrients that reduce pain and improve mobility. Antioxidants — Renal Joint Protection — Vitamins E and C, selenium — reducing oxidative stress that accelerates both kidney damage and cartilage degradation. Alkalizing Effect — Metabolic acidosis is a common complication of CKD — the formula's alkalizing effect supports acid-base balance and reduces the muscle wasting that acidosis causes. High Palatability — Clinical diets are only effective if the cat eats them — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent consumption by cats who may have reduced appetite secondary to CKD. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of both the 400g and 1.5kg Virbac HPM bags, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable senior cat — communicating the quality of life that effective clinical management supports.) Product Details Features The Senior Cat — Why CKD and Joint Disease Co-Occur Chronic kidney disease and osteoarthritis are the two most prevalent conditions in senior cats — and they frequently occur together in the same patient for interconnected reasons: Prevalence: CKD affects approximately 30–40% of cats over 10 years of age and up to 80% of cats over 15 years Osteoarthritis affects approximately 60–90% of cats over 10 years of age — significantly underdiagnosed because cats hide pain effectively Shared risk factors: Age — Both conditions are age-related — the same aging processes that cause kidney nephron loss also cause cartilage degradation Chronic inflammation — Systemic chronic inflammation drives both renal fibrosis (CKD progression) and synovial inflammation (joint disease progression) Oxidative stress — Free radical damage accelerates both kidney cell death and cartilage degradation Reduced physical activity — Joint pain reduces activity, which reduces muscle mass, which reduces joint support, which worsens joint pain — a vicious cycle that also reduces renal perfusion The clinical challenge: Managing CKD and joint disease simultaneously creates a nutritional tension that standard single-indication diets cannot resolve: Kidney diets restrict protein to reduce uremic toxin production — but protein restriction risks muscle wasting that worsens joint disease Joint support diets provide adequate protein for muscle maintenance — but standard protein levels increase renal workload in CKD cats Virbac HPM Cat Advanced Kidney Joint resolves this tension through precise formulation — the right protein qua

item.g:title: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pet
item.g:description: IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli for Pets The feeding bowl that refills itself. The IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli takes the elegant, pebble-inspired design of the Ciottoli range and elevates it into a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in 1.5L and 3L capacities, it's the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the peace of mind that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as considered as everything else in their home. Why IMac Food Dispenser Ciottoli Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Ciottoli design language — the same smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic that defines the Ciottoli bowl range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines Reduces feeding frequency — ideal for busy owners, short trips away, or households where consistent manual feeding times are difficult to maintain Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's low center of gravity and wide footprint keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Transparent reservoir — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details Features Gravity dispensers work on a simple, reliable principle: food is stored in an upper reservoir and flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. There are no batteries, no electronics, and no moving parts to maintain or replace — just a clean, passive mechanism that keeps the bowl consistently stocked as long as the reservoir has food in it. The IMac Ciottoli Dispenser applies this principle within the Ciottoli design framework — maintaining the smooth, rounded aesthetic of the bowl range while adding the practical functionality of a reservoir system. The result is a feeding station that looks like a considered design object rather than a utilitarian plastic container, and that performs reliably day after day without requiring attention. The 1.5L capacity (27×19×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing enough food for 1–2 days of free-feeding for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (29.5×23.5×29cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. The transparent reservoir section allows owners to monitor food levels at a glance — no need to open the unit or estimate by weight. When the reservoir runs low, simply open the top, refill, and the dispenser takes care of the rest. Key Features: Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — no batteries or electronics required Italian Ciottoli design — smooth, rounded pebble-inspired aesthetic 2 sizes: 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacity Transparent reservoir for easy food level monitoring Wide, stable base — anti-tip design Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Suitable for cats and dogs Ideal for free-feeding, busy households, and short trips

item.g:title: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pet
item.g:description: IMac Dea Food Dispenser for Pets The feeding station that works while you don't. The IMac Dea Food Dispenser brings the clean, considered design of the Dea range to a fully functional gravity-fed dispenser — a reservoir unit that automatically releases food into the bowl as your pet eats, keeping the feeding station consistently stocked without constant manual refilling. Available in Blue and Red, in 1.5L and 3L capacities, the Dea Dispenser is the practical, beautiful solution for busy households, free-feeding routines, and owners who want the confidence that their pet always has food available — in a unit that looks as intentional as everything else in their home. Why IMac Dea Food Dispenser Is the Best Choice Gravity-fed auto-refill mechanism — as your pet eats from the bowl, food flows down from the reservoir automatically, maintaining a consistent level without any manual intervention between fills Italian Dea design language — the same clean, rounded aesthetic that defines the Dea range, now in a full dispenser format; functional and beautiful in equal measure Available in Blue and Red — two bold color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate dispensers in multi-pet households 1.5L and 3L reservoir capacities — the 1.5L suits cats and small dogs with 1–2 days of food between fills; the 3L handles larger dogs or multi-day free-feeding routines No batteries or electronics — the gravity mechanism is passive, reliable, and maintenance-free; nothing to charge, replace, or repair Transparent reservoir section — allows easy visual monitoring of food levels without opening or moving the unit Stable, wide-base design — the dispenser's footprint and low center of gravity keep it stable even during enthusiastic feeding Suitable for both cats and dogs — the dispenser format works across species and feeding styles Product Details Features The Dea Food Dispenser operates on the same reliable gravity principle as the Ciottoli Dispenser — food stored in an upper reservoir flows down by gravity into the bowl below as the bowl empties. The mechanism is entirely passive: no batteries, no electronics, no moving parts. It works continuously and silently, requiring attention only when the reservoir needs refilling. What distinguishes the Dea Dispenser from the Ciottoli Dispenser is the design language. Where the Ciottoli range is defined by its smooth, pebble-inspired rounded form, the Dea range has its own distinct aesthetic identity — and the Dea Dispenser maintains that identity in a full-height dispenser format. The result is a feeding station that integrates naturally into a home environment as a considered design object rather than a purely utilitarian appliance. The color options — Blue and Red — add a further dimension of personalization that the Ciottoli Dispenser (available in a single colorway) doesn't offer. For multi-pet households where visual differentiation between feeding stations is useful, or simply for owners who want their pet's feeding area to reflect a specific color palette, the Dea Dispenser provides that flexibility. The 1.5L capacity (26×18.5×24cm) is well-suited to cats and small dogs — providing 1–2 days of free-feeding capacity for most cats, or a full day's portion for small breeds. The 3L capacity (33.5×24×29.5cm) scales up for medium-to-large dogs or multi-cat households where a larger reserve between fills is more practical. dead hair before it sheds around your home Prevents painful mats and tangles from forming Distributes natural skin oils for a healthy, shiny coat Stimulates blood circulation to the skin Provides bonding time with your pet Allows you to check for skin issues, parasites, or lumps Reduces hairballs in cats Keeps your pet comfortable and looking their best Grooming Tips: Always comb in the direction of hair growth Use gentle, smooth strokes Never force the comb through severe mats (consult a groomer) Pay special attention to areas prone to tangling: behind ears, under legs, tail Combine with brushing for complete coat care Make grooming a positive experience with treats and praise Groom in a well-lit area to see the coat clearly Care Maintenance: Remove hair from the comb after each use Wash with warm, soapy water regularly Rinse thoroughly and dry completely Disinfect periodically with pet-safe cleaner Store in a clean, dry location Check teeth regularly for damage or bending Replace if teeth become damaged or loose

Developed by VIRBAC, a globally recognized leader in veterinary products, Effitix combines two active ingredients to deliver broad-spectrum parasite control through a simple spot-on application. The Large variant is formulated for dogs weighing between 20 and 40 kg, making it suitable for a wide range of medium-to-large breeds. Applied directly to the skin between the shoulder blades, it spreads over the coat and skin to provide full-body protection against external parasites for up to four weeks. For dogs that are difficult to medicate orally, or for owners who prefer topical treatments, Effitix is an excellent option that is easy to apply and highly effective. Product Features For dogs weighing 20 to 40 kg Monthly topical spot-on application Kills and repels fleas, ticks, and biting insects Dual active ingredient formula for enhanced efficacy Applied between the shoulder blades for even distribution Provides up to 4 weeks of protection per application Suitable for dogs with difficulty accepting oral treatments From VIRBAC, a trusted international veterinary brand Active Ingredients Permethrin and Fipronil – a synergistic combination that kills and repels a broad spectrum of external parasites. How to Apply Part the fur between the shoulder blades to expose the skin. Apply the entire contents of the pipette directly to the skin. Avoid contact with the dog's eyes or mouth. Do not bathe the dog for 48 hours before or after application. Dosing Guide Dog Weight Variant Application Interval 20 - 40 kg Effitix Large Every 4 weeks Do not use on cats. Perfecto Cat delivers these nutrients daily in the treat format that cats actually want to eat — the satisfying crunch of the cushion shell, the soft functional filling inside, and the German precision that ensures consistent, reliable formulation. 50g per pack — the daily coat health treat that makes the difference you can see and feel. Biotin (Vitamin B7) — The coat vitamin — biotin is essential for keratin synthesis, the structural protein that forms hair and nails. Biotin deficiency causes brittle, dull, slow-growing coat. Zinc — Supporting skin cell turnover, sebum production, and the wound healing that maintains healthy skin barrier function. Product Details Features Coat Quality as a Nutritional Signal A cat's coat is one of the most visible indicators of their overall nutritional status — and understanding the relationship between nutrition and coat quality explains why the Perfecto Cat Haar Fell treats are so effective: What a healthy coat looks like: Glossy — A healthy coat reflects light evenly — the result of adequate sebum production and intact cuticle structure Smooth — Individual hairs lie flat and smooth — the result of healthy keratin structure and adequate hydration Dense — Healthy hair follicles produce dense, full coat coverage Low-shedding — Healthy hair follicles hold hairs firmly — excessive shedding indicates follicle stress or nutritional deficiency Soft — Healthy coat is soft to the touch — rough, coarse texture indicates keratin quality issues What causes poor coat quality: Omega-3 deficiency — The most common nutritional cause of dull, rough, shedding coat — Omega-3 fatty acids are essential for skin barrier integrity and hair follicle health Biotin deficiency — Causes brittle, dull, slow-growing coat — biotin is essential for keratin synthesis Zinc deficiency — Causes skin scaling, coat thinning, and reduced sebum production Protein deficiency — Hair is primarily protein (keratin) — inadequate protein intake directly reduces coat quality Dehydration — Chronic dehydration reduces skin hydration and coat quality The Key Coat Health Nutrients Omega-3 Fatty Acids (EPA DHA) — The Primary Coat Nutrient: Omega-3 fatty acids are the most important dietary nutrients for feline coat health — and their mechanism of action is well-established: Skin barrier integrity: The skin barrier is composed of skin cells (corneocytes) embedded in a lipid matrix — and Omega-3 fatty acids are essential components of this lipid matrix. Adequate Omega-3 intake: Maintains the integrity of the lipid matrix — preventing moisture loss and environmental irritant penetration Supports skin cell membrane fluidity — allowing cells to function normally and turn over at the app

item.g:title: IMac Diva Single Bowl for Pet
item.g:description: IMac Diva Bowl for Pets The most versatile bowl in the IMac range. The Diva Bowl brings Italian design sensibility to a classic, upright bowl format — available in four sizes that span the full range from small cats and toy breeds to large and giant breed dogs, and in two bold colors that make it as much a design statement as a feeding solution. Clean lines, a taller profile, and the same commitment to quality that defines every IMac product — the Diva is the bowl for owners who want the right size, the right color, and the right aesthetic, all in one. Why IMac Diva Bowl Is the Best Choice Four sizes for every pet — from 0.40L for small cats and toy breeds to 2.8L for large and giant breed dogs, the Diva range covers the complete spectrum of pet sizes in a single, consistent design language Available in Blue and Red — two bold, distinct color options that allow personalization, aesthetic matching to your home, or easy visual differentiation between bowls in multi-pet households Taller, upright bowl profile — the Diva's more cylindrical form is particularly well-suited to pets who prefer a deeper bowl, and to longer-eared breeds where a taller, narrower bowl keeps ears out of the food Italian IMac design — the clean, considered aesthetic that IMac is known for, applied to a classic bowl format that works in any home environment Smooth interior surfaces — no corners or crevices where food residue can accumulate; easy to clean thoroughly after every use Stable base design — proportioned to stay in place during feeding without tipping or sliding Suitable for both cats and dogs — a single product line that works across species at every size Product Details Features The Diva Bowl occupies a distinct position in the IMac lineup. Where the Ciottoli is defined by its flat, pebble-inspired form and the Dea by its rounded, low-profile design, the Diva brings a taller, more upright bowl profile that serves a different set of practical needs. The taller form is particularly valuable for certain breeds and feeding situations. Long-eared dogs — Cocker Spaniels, Basset Hounds, Beagles — benefit significantly from a taller, narrower bowl that keeps their ears elevated above the food surface, reducing the mess and hygiene issues that come with ears dragging through wet food. Cats who prefer to eat without their whiskers touching the bowl sides — a common sensitivity known as whisker fatigue — may also find the Diva's proportions more comfortable than very wide, shallow bowls. The four-size range is the most comprehensive in the IMac bowl lineup, making the Diva the natural choice for households with multiple pets of significantly different sizes, or for owners who want a single bowl design that can scale with a growing puppy from small to large. The two color options — Blue and Red — add a dimension of personalization that makes the Diva stand out in the IMac range. Whether you're matching a color scheme, differentiating between a food bowl and a water bowl, or simply choosing the color your cat or dog seems to prefer, the Diva gives you that choice without compromising on quality or design. Key Features: Italian IMac design — clean, upright bowl aesthetic Available in Blue and Red 4 sizes: 0.40L, 0.9L, 1.9L, 2.8L Taller, more cylindrical profile — ideal for long-eared breeds and whisker-sensitive cats Smooth interior surfaces — easy to clean Stable base — anti-tip design Suitable for cats and dogs of all sizes

item.g:title: Virbac Cat Urology Urinary WIB 1.5Kg
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Cat Urology Urinary WIB | 400g / 1.5kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Cat Food The urinary diet that protects against both crystal types. Virbac HPM Cat Urology Urinary WIB is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry cat food specifically formulated to support feline urinary health — preventing and managing the full spectrum of feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD), including struvite crystals, calcium oxalate crystals, idiopathic cystitis, and urethral plugs. The "WIB" designation reflects the most clinically sophisticated aspect of this formula — a precisely balanced mineral profile that simultaneously prevents struvite crystal formation and calcium oxalate crystal formation, the two most common urinary crystal types in cats. Most urinary diets address one crystal type effectively but inadvertently promote the other — acidifying diets dissolve struvite but increase calcium oxalate risk; alkalizing diets prevent calcium oxalate but promote struvite. Virbac HPM Urinary WIB navigates this clinical tension through precise mineral balance, controlled pH targeting, and high moisture encouragement — protecting the entire urinary tract without compromising against either crystal type. Available in 400g (trial size) and 1.5kg. Why Virbac HPM Cat Urology Urinary WIB Is The Best Choice Dual Crystal Protection — Struvite Calcium Oxalate — The WIB formula simultaneously prevents both struvite and calcium oxalate crystal formation — the most clinically complete urinary protection available in a single diet. Balanced Mineral Profile — Precisely controlled magnesium, calcium, phosphorus, and sodium levels — reducing the mineral concentrations that drive crystal formation without creating the imbalances that promote the opposite crystal type. Optimal Urine pH Targeting — Targets a urine pH range that is unfavorable for both struvite (alkaline) and calcium oxalate (acidic) crystal formation — the narrow pH window where both crystal types are minimized. High Moisture Encouragement — Formulated to encourage water intake and increase urine volume — diluting the mineral concentrations that drive crystal formation and reducing urine specific gravity. Struvite Dissolution Support — The formula supports the dissolution of existing struvite crystals and prevents new struvite formation — the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats. Calcium Oxalate Prevention — Prevents calcium oxalate crystal formation — the most common crystal type in older cats and the crystal type that cannot be dissolved by diet alone. Idiopathic Cystitis Support — Stress-reducing and anti-inflammatory nutritional support for cats with feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — the most common cause of FLUTD in young cats. High Palatability — Clinical urinary diets must be consumed consistently — the Virbac HPM formula is formulated for high palatability to ensure consistent daily consumption. Two Sizes — 400g trial size for initial introduction; 1.5kg for ongoing management. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of both the 400g and 1.5kg Virbac HPM Urinary WIB bags, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, healthy cat — communicating the urinary health and comfort the clinical diet supports.) Product Details Features Understanding Feline Lower Urinary Tract Disease (FLUTD) FLUTD is an umbrella term for a group of conditions affecting the bladder and urethra of cats — and it is one of the most common reasons cats are presented to veterinarians. Understanding the spectrum of FLUTD conditions explains why the WIB formula's comprehensive approach is clinically superior to single-indication urinary diets: Prevalence: FLUTD affects approximately 1–3% of cats annually Recurrence rates are high — 30–50% of cats experience recurrence within 12 months without dietary management Male cats are at significantly higher risk of urethral obstruction — a life-threatening emergency The FLUTD spectrum: Feline idiopathic cystitis (FIC) — 55–65% of FLUTD cases: FIC is the most common cause of FLUTD in cats under 10 years — characterized by bladder inflammation without an identifiable cause. Stress is the primary trigger — environmental changes, multi-cat households, indoor confinement, and routine disruption all increase FIC risk. Clinical signs include straining to urinate, blood in urine, frequent urination of small amounts, and urinating outside the litter box. Struvite crystals/uroliths — 15–20% of FLUTD cases: Struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) crystals form in alkaline urine with high magnesium and phosphorus concentrations. They are the most common crystal type in young to middle-aged cats and can be dissolved by dietary acidification and mineral restriction. Calcium oxalate crystals/uroliths — 10–15% of FLUTD cases: Calcium oxalate crystals form in acidic urine with high calcium and oxalate concentrations. They are the most common crystal type in older cats (>7 years) a

item.g:description: Perfecto Cat — Catsticks Mit Kaninchen Geflügel (Rabbit Poultry) | 10 Sticks × 5g | 50g | Premium Cat Treat The most ancestrally authentic treat in the Perfecto Cat range. Catsticks Mit Kaninchen Geflügel brings together rabbit — the protein that most closely resembles the ancestral feline prey diet — and poultry as the universally appealing, familiar base, in the satisfying chewy stick format that cats hold, chew, and devour with natural instinct. Rabbit is the rarest and most nutritionally exceptional protein in commercial cat food — genuinely novel for virtually every domestic cat, exceptionally lean, exceptionally digestible, and the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. Poultry provides the familiar palatability foundation that ensures the formula is accepted enthusiastically even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Together, they create the most biologically appropriate and nutritionally distinctive treat in the Perfecto Cat range — 10 individual sticks of German quality, in the protein combination that nature intended. 50g per pack — the ancestral treat for the modern cat. Why Perfecto Cat Catsticks Rabbit Poultry Is The Best Choice Rabbit — The Most Ancestrally Authentic Protein — Rabbit is the protein that most closely resembles the small prey that cats evolved to hunt — the most biologically appropriate protein available in commercial cat food. Genuinely Novel Protein — Virtually no domestic cat has ever eaten rabbit — making this the most novel protein available in the Perfecto Cat range, ideal for cats with sensitivities to common proteins or who need dietary variety. Exceptionally Lean — Rabbit is one of the leanest animal proteins available — lower in fat than chicken, turkey, or beef — ideal for cats who need high-quality protein without excessive caloric density. Exceptionally Digestible — Rabbit's fine muscle fiber structure makes it one of the most digestible proteins available — maximizing nutrient absorption and minimizing digestive stress. Poultry — The Familiar Foundation — The universally appealing poultry base that provides complete protein, natural taurine, and the familiar palatability that ensures the formula is accepted even by cats encountering rabbit for the first time. Dual Novel + Familiar Protein — Rabbit's novelty and poultry's familiarity create the ideal introduction to novel protein feeding — the cat accepts the familiar poultry while being exposed to the nutritional benefits of rabbit. Natural Taurine from Both Proteins — Both rabbit and poultry are natural taurine sources — the essential amino acid cats cannot synthesize. 10 Individual Sticks — Pre-portioned into 10 individual sticks of ~5g each — perfect daily portion control. Stick Format — The elongated stick format that cats hold between their paws and chew — engaging natural holding and chewing behaviors. German Quality — Perfecto Cat — A trusted German pet food brand with rigorous quality standards. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a cat holding and chewing a Perfecto Cat stick, or flat-lay of the 10 sticks fanned out from the pack.) Product Details Features Rabbit — The Ancestral Feline Protein Rabbit is the most significant and distinctive ingredient in this formula — and understanding why rabbit is so exceptional for cats explains why this is the most nutritionally meaningful treat in the Perfecto Cat range. The ancestral diet connection: Domestic cats ( Felis catus ) evolved from the African wildcat ( Felis silvestris lybica ) — a small predator whose natural prey consisted primarily of small mammals (mice, rats, rabbits, hares) and birds. Rabbit and hare were a significant component of the ancestral feline diet — making rabbit the protein that cats are most biologically designed to eat. The nutritional profile of rabbit closely matches the nutritional requirements that feline physiology evolved around: High protein, low fat — matching the lean muscle of small prey Complete amino acid profile — all essential amino acids in proportions that match feline requirements Natural taurine — the essential amino acid that cats evolved to obtain from prey meat Low carbohydrate — matching the near-zero carbohydrate content of whole prey Why rabbit is rare in commercial cat food: Despite being the most biologically appropriate protein for cats, rabbit is rare in commercial cat food — the result of: Higher ingredient cost compared to chicken, tuna, or beef Lower supply chain availability and scalability Less consumer familiarity in most markets Its inclusion in Perfecto Cat Catsticks reflects a genuine commitment to premium ingredient quality — and makes this the most nutritionally distinctive treat in the range. item.g:title: Virbac Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein | 3kg | Veterinary Clinical Dry Dog Food The gold standard for canine food allergy management. Virbac HPM Dog Hypoallergy With Hydrolysed Fish Protein is a veterinary clinical nutrition dry dog food formulated using hydrolysed fish protein — the most scientifically validated approach to eliminating food allergy reactions in dogs. Hydrolysis is the process of breaking protein molecules into fragments so small that the immune system can no longer recognize and react to them — eliminating the allergenic trigger at the molecular level rather than simply avoiding common allergens. This is not a "grain-free" or "limited ingredient" commercial food — it is a genuine clinical hypoallergenic diet, developed by Virbac's veterinary nutritionists and validated through clinical research, for dogs with confirmed or suspected food allergies and food intolerances. For dogs who have failed standard elimination diets, who react to multiple protein sources, or who require the most rigorous hypoallergenic formulation available — Virbac HPM Hypoallergy is the clinical answer. 3kg of veterinary-grade hypoallergenic nutrition — the diet that eliminates the reaction at its source. Why Virbac HPM Dog Hypoallergy Hydrolysed Fish Protein Is The Best Choice Hydrolysed Fish Protein — The Gold Standard — Protein hydrolysis breaks fish protein into peptide fragments below the molecular weight threshold that triggers immune recognition — eliminating the allergenic response at the molecular level. True Hypoallergenic Formulation — Not a "limited ingredient" or "grain-free" commercial food — a genuine veterinary clinical hypoallergenic diet formulated to the most rigorous hypoallergenic standards. Fish as the Hydrolysed Protein Source — Fish is selected as the hydrolysis substrate for its high digestibility, complete amino acid profile, and status as a novel protein for most dogs who have been fed chicken or beef-based diets. Elimination Diet Standard — Suitable for use as the elimination diet in food allergy diagnosis protocols — the clinical standard for identifying food allergy triggers. Long-Term Management Diet — Suitable for long-term feeding as the primary diet for dogs with confirmed food allergies — providing complete and balanced nutrition without allergenic triggers. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — the same scientific rigor applied to Virbac's pharmaceutical products, applied to clinical nutrition. Complete Balanced — Provides complete and balanced nutrition for adult dogs — all essential nutrients in appropriate proportions despite the clinical formulation. Addresses Multiple Allergy Manifestations — Suitable for food allergy presenting as skin conditions (atopic dermatitis, pruritus), gastrointestinal symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting), or both. 3kg Clinical Pack — A practical clinical diet size for ongoing management. (Visual asset placement: flat-lay of the Virbac HPM Hypoallergy bag with the clinical branding prominent, or lifestyle photo of a comfortable, itch-free dog — communicating the relief that the hypoallergenic diet provides.) Product Details Features Understanding Canine Food Allergy — The Problem This Diet Solves Food allergy in dogs is an immune-mediated adverse reaction to one or more dietary proteins — the immune system incorrectly identifies a food protein as a threat and mounts an inflammatory response. Understanding the mechanism explains why hydrolysed protein is the most effective solution: How food allergy develops: Sensitization — The dog is repeatedly exposed to a dietary protein (most commonly chicken, beef, dairy, wheat, or egg) Immune recognition — The immune system produces IgE antibodies specific to that protein Reaction — On subsequent exposure, the protein binds to IgE antibodies on mast cells — triggering the release of histamine and other inflammatory mediators Symptoms — The inflammatory response produces the clinical signs of food allergy Common food allergy symptoms in dogs: Skin — Pruritus (itching), erythema (redness), papules, alopecia (hair loss), recurrent ear infections, paw licking and chewing Gastrointestinal — Chronic diarrhea, vomiting, flatulence, increased bowel movement frequency Combined — Many dogs present with both skin and gastrointestinal symptoms simultaneously Why standard elimination diets often fail: Standard "limited ingredient" or "novel protein" commercial diets frequently fail to resolve food allergy because: Cross-contamination during manufacturing introduces trace amounts of common allergens The "novel" protein may not be truly novel for the individual dog Intact proteins — even from novel sources — can still trigger immune recognition in sensitized dogs Why Hydrolysed Protein Is the Gold Standard Hydrolysis is the process of breaking protein molecules into smaller fragments (peptides) using enzymes or acid — and it is the most scientifically validate

item.g:title: Royal Canin Digestive Care Dog Pouch Loaf 85g
item.g:description: Details Wet food for dogs Complete feed for dogs - For adult dogs over 10 months old - Dogs prone to digestive sensitivity. PRODUCT DETAILS Digestive sensitivities in dogs can often be identified by the consistency and frequency of their stools. Larger dogs with upset stomachs tend to produce runnier stools at a higher frequency, while smaller dogs tend to experience constipation and produce more solid stools. A wide variety of different factors can influence digestive sensitivities in dogs, including age, weight, and breed. But with the right diet, your dog can benefit from nutrients that help to support healthy digestion. ROYAL CANIN® Digestive Care Loaf is a precisely balanced nutritional formula that is specifically created to support healthier digestion in dogs with digestive sensitivities. This food is suitable for dogs of all breeds, shapes and sizes. A diet that is too varied can result in further digestive issues and upset the balance of the good bacteria, or 'microflora' , in your dog's gut. Microflora encourages a healthy digestive environment and can be supported by the right diet containing the right nutrients. This food contains specially selected nutrients that are highly digestible and easy to absorb. The exclusive blend of fibres, prebiotics and protein in this product help to facilitate a good digestive environment that supports healthy digestion. Composition: Meat and animal derivatives, cereals, derivatives of vegetable origin, minerals. Additives (per kg): Nutritional additives: Vitamin D3: 170 IU, Iron (3b103): 5 mg, Iodine (3b202): 0.25 mg, Copper (3b405, 3b406): 2 mg, Manganese (3b502, 3b503, 3b504): 1.5 mg, Zinc (3b603, 3b605, 3b606): 15 mg - Technological additives: Clinoptilolite of sedimentary origin: 2.2 g. Analytical constituents: Protein: 8.6% - Crude fibres: 1.3% - Fat content: 5.8% - Crude ash: 1.8% - Moisture: 78.9%.

item.g:title: Virbac Pyoderm for Dog & Cat 250ML VBI
item.g:description: Virbac — Pyoderm | 250ml | Veterinary Antibacterial Shampoo for Dogs Cats The veterinary standard for bacterial skin infections. Virbac Pyoderm is a veterinary-grade antibacterial shampoo specifically formulated to treat pyoderma — bacterial skin infections — and associated skin conditions in dogs and cats. Pyoderma is one of the most common dermatological conditions in dogs and a significant cause of skin disease in cats — characterized by bacterial colonization of the skin that produces pustules, papules, crusts, scaling, hair loss, redness, and the characteristic unpleasant odor of infected skin. Standard grooming shampoos cannot treat pyoderma — bacterial skin infections require the specific antibacterial active ingredients that only veterinary-grade shampoos provide. Virbac Pyoderm delivers clinically proven antibacterial action — targeting the bacteria responsible for canine and feline pyoderma, reducing the bacterial burden on infected skin, supporting the resolution of active infections, and preventing recurrence when used as part of a comprehensive dermatological management program. From Virbac — the veterinary dermatology brand that professionals trust worldwide. 250ml — the veterinary antibacterial shampoo that treats pyoderma at its source. Why Virbac Pyoderm Is The Best Choice Veterinary Antibacterial Formula — Specifically formulated to treat pyoderma and bacterial skin infections — not a general grooming shampoo, but a genuine veterinary antibacterial treatment. Chlorhexidine — The Gold Standard Veterinary Antibacterial — Chlorhexidine is the most widely used and most clinically validated antibacterial agent in veterinary dermatology — broad-spectrum, residual activity, and excellent safety profile. Broad-Spectrum Antibacterial Coverage — Effective against the primary bacterial pathogens responsible for canine and feline pyoderma — particularly Staphylococcus pseudintermedius, the most common cause of canine pyoderma. Residual Antibacterial Activity — Chlorhexidine binds to skin proteins and maintains antibacterial activity between baths — providing ongoing protection beyond the bathing session. Surface Decontamination — Reduces the bacterial burden on the skin surface — supporting the resolution of active infections and preventing recolonization. Adjunctive Therapy — Used alongside systemic antibiotics for moderate to severe pyoderma — topical antibacterial shampoo reduces the bacterial burden and supports faster resolution. Monotherapy for Superficial Pyoderma — For mild, superficial pyoderma, topical antibacterial shampoo alone may be sufficient — reducing the need for systemic antibiotics. Recurrence Prevention — Regular use as a maintenance shampoo prevents bacterial recolonization in dogs prone to recurrent pyoderma. For Dogs Cats — Formulated for use in both species. Product Details Features Understanding Pyoderma in Dogs and Cats Pyoderma (from the Greek "pyo" = pus, "derma" = skin) is a bacterial skin infection — one of the most common dermatological conditions in dogs and a significant cause of skin disease in cats. Understanding pyoderma explains why a veterinary antibacterial shampoo is essential for effective management: Prevalence: Pyoderma is the most common skin condition in dogs — accounting for approximately 20–30% of all dermatological consultations In cats, pyoderma is less common but occurs secondary to wounds, bite injuries, and underlying skin conditions Classification by depth: Superficial pyoderma: Infection confined to the surface of the skin and hair follicle openings Presents as pustules, papules, epidermal collarettes (circular scales), and superficial crusts Most common form — often responds to topical antibacterial treatment alone Includes impetigo (puppy pyoderma), superficial bacterial folliculitis, and mucocutaneous pyoderma Deep pyoderma: Infection extending into the dermis and subcutaneous tissue Presents as nodules, draining tracts, furunculosis (ruptured hair follicles), and cellulitis Requires systemic antibiotic therapy — topical treatment is adjunctive More serious — can cause scarring and systemic illness Causes and risk factors: Pyoderma is almost always secondary to an underlying condition that disrupts the skin barrier or immune defense: Allergies — Atopic dermatitis (environmental allergy) and food allergy are the most common underlying causes — the chronic scratching and skin barrier disruption allow bacteria to colonize Parasites — Demodicosis (Demodex mites) causes immunosuppression that allows bacterial overgrowth Hormonal disorders — Hypothyroidism and hyperadrenocorticism (Cushing's disease) impair immune function Anatomical factors — Skin folds (in brachycephalic bre

item.g:title: Virbac Puppy Small & Toy 3KG
item.g:description: Virbac HPM — Puppy Small Toy | 3kg | Veterinary-Grade Dry Puppy Food The foundation of a healthy small breed life. Virbac HPM Puppy Small Toy is a veterinary-grade growth diet specifically formulated for the unique nutritional requirements of small and toy breed puppies — the breeds whose rapid early development, high metabolic rate, and small stomach capacity demand a fundamentally different nutritional approach from medium and large breed puppy foods. Small and toy breed puppies are not simply smaller versions of large breed puppies — they grow faster relative to their adult size, reach maturity earlier, burn more calories per kilogram of body weight, and have smaller mouths and stomachs that require smaller kibble and higher energy density per gram of food. Virbac HPM Puppy Small Toy is formulated to address every one of these specific requirements — high energy density for the small breed metabolic rate, optimal protein for rapid muscle and organ development, precise calcium and phosphorus ratios for small breed skeletal development, DHA for brain and vision development, and a kibble size designed for small mouths. Veterinary-grade nutrition from Virbac — the animal health company that applies pharmaceutical-grade scientific rigor to every product it produces. 3kg — the growth diet that gives small breed puppies the nutritional foundation they deserve. Why Virbac HPM Puppy Small Toy Is The Best Choice Small Toy Breed Specific — Formulated specifically for the unique metabolic, developmental, and physical requirements of small and toy breed puppies — not a generic puppy food adapted for small breeds. High Energy Density — Small and toy breed puppies have a metabolic rate 2–3× higher per kilogram than large breeds — the high energy density formula meets this elevated caloric requirement in the small portions their stomachs can accommodate. Optimal Protein for Rapid Development — High-quality protein supporting the rapid muscle, organ, and tissue development that characterizes the small breed growth phase. Precise Calcium Phosphorus Ratios — Carefully calibrated calcium and phosphorus levels for small breed skeletal development — avoiding the over-supplementation that can cause developmental orthopedic disease. DHA for Brain Vision Development — Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) is the critical Omega-3 for neurological and retinal development — supporting cognitive development and visual acuity during the critical early growth phase. Small Kibble Size — Kibble sized for small mouths and developing teeth — ensuring comfortable eating and adequate chewing for small and toy breed puppies. Immune System Support — Antioxidants and immune-supporting nutrients for the developing immune system of growing puppies. Digestive Support — Highly digestible ingredients and prebiotic fiber supporting the sensitive digestive system of small breed puppies. Virbac HPM — Veterinary Expertise — From one of the world's leading animal health companies — veterinary-grade nutrition for the most critical phase of your dog's life. Complete Balanced for Growth — Formulated to meet the AAFCO/FEDIAF nutritional standards for growth — all essential nutrients for complete puppy development. (Visual asset placement: lifestyle photo of a small or toy breed puppy eating from a bowl of Virbac HPM kibble, or flat-lay of the bag with a small breed puppy alongside — communicating the breed-specific positioning.) Product Details Features Why Small Toy Breed Puppies Need a Specific Formula The distinction between small/toy breed puppy nutrition and general puppy nutrition is not a marketing differentiation — it reflects genuine, clinically significant differences in the physiology and development of small breed dogs: Growth rate and maturity timeline: Small/toy breeds (adult weight <10 kg) — Reach adult size at 8–12 months Medium breeds (adult weight 10–25 kg) — Reach adult size at 12–15 months Large breeds (adult weight 25–45 kg) — Reach adult size at 15–18 months Giant breeds (adult weight >45 kg) — Reach adult size at 18–24 months Small and toy breed puppies complete their growth in a shorter period — but their growth is proportionally more rapid relative to their adult size. This rapid growth requires higher energy density and higher protein concentration per gram of food than slower-growing large breed puppies. Metabolic rate: Small and toy breed dogs have a significantly higher metabolic rate per kilogram of body weight than large breeds — a consequence of their higher surface-area-to-volume ratio (smaller bodies lose heat more rapidly and must generate more heat per kilogram to maintain body temperature). This elevated metabolic rate means: Small breed puppies require more calories per kilogram of body weight than large breed puppies They must eat more frequently relative to their body size Their food must be more energy-dense — they cannot eat enough volume to meet their caloric needs from a low-density food Stomach capacity: Small and toy breed

item.g:title: IMac Dea Slow Food for Pet
item.g:description: IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder for Pets Fast eaters are a common problem — and a genuinely risky one. Dogs and cats who eat too quickly swallow excess air alongside their food, leading to bloating, vomiting, regurgitation, and in severe cases, the life-threatening condition known as gastric dilatation-volvulus (GDV) in dogs. The IMac Dea Slow Food Feeder is designed to solve this at the source: a beautifully designed Italian slow feeder bowl with a patterned interior that naturally slows eating pace, improves digestion, and turns every meal into a more mindful, healthier experience. Available in Blue and Red, in two sizes for cats and dogs of all breeds. Why IMac Dea Slow Feeder Is the Best Choice Slows eating pace by design — the raised interior pattern forces pets to eat around obstacles, naturally reducing consumption speed by up to 10× compared to a standard flat bowl Reduces bloat and digestive discomfort — slower eating means less air swallowed, fewer episodes of vomiting or regurgitation, and significantly reduced risk of the bloating that fast eating causes Provides mental enrichment — working around the feeder's pattern engages a pet's problem-solving instincts, turning mealtime into a stimulating activity rather than a race to the bottom of the bowl Italian IMac design — the Dea's clean, considered aesthetic brings the same design quality as the rest of the IMac range to a functional health product; it looks as good as it performs Available in Blue and Red — two color options to suit your home's aesthetic or to differentiate bowls in multi-pet households Two sizes for cats and dogs — the 0.45L suits cats and small breeds; the 0.9L handles medium-to-large dogs comfortably Full SKU and barcode coverage on all variants ✓ — excellent product data quality Product Details Features The science behind slow feeders is straightforward: when pets eat too fast, they consume food in large, rapid gulps that introduce significant amounts of air into the stomach. This air accumulation causes bloating, discomfort, and vomiting — and in large and deep-chested dog breeds, it can escalate to GDV, a surgical emergency. Slowing the eating pace eliminates the root cause of these issues without requiring any dietary changes or medication. The IMac Dea achieves this through its interior pattern — raised ridges and channels that divide the bowl's surface into sections, requiring pets to navigate around them to access their food. This simple mechanism is highly effective: most pets slow their eating pace significantly within the first few uses, and the behavioral change tends to persist even when they occasionally eat from a standard bowl. Beyond the health benefit, slow feeders provide a form of daily mental enrichment that is particularly valuable for indoor pets. The problem-solving engagement of working around the feeder's pattern activates the same instincts as foraging — a natural behavior that indoor cats and dogs rarely get to express. For pets who finish their meals in seconds and then spend the rest of the day looking for stimulation, a slow feeder transforms mealtime into a genuinely engaging activity. The Dea's design maintains IMac's commitment to aesthetic quality — a clean, rounded form in two bold colors that integrates naturally into any home environment without looking like a medical device. Key Features: Slow feeder interior pattern — reduces eating speed by up to 10× Reduces bloat, vomiting, and digestive discomfort Provides mental enrichment through foraging-style engagement Italian IMac design — clean, rounded aesthetic Available in Blue and Red 2 sizes: 0.45L and 0.9L Suitable for cats and dogs All variants have SKUs and barcodes ✓
